The simulation results show that with the existing energy storage technology, investing user-side BESS is not yet economically feasible. Finally, incentive policies to facilitate the development of user-side battery energy storage are discussed.

articleTitle: Multi-microgrid coordinate dispatching of multi-time scale source-load supply and demand interaction based on master-slave game theory
abstract: The microgrid is increasingly decentralized, autonomous and intelligent, what's more, there will be a large number of microgrids connection in the future. The diversification and complication of market players have brought great challenges to the active distribution network scheduling operation. The prediction error of the new energy output of the microgrid has brought some difficulties to the scheduling. Based on using the complementarity of space-time between the source-load and multi-microgrids at different time scales, and coordinating scheduling between multi-microgrids is an effective way to improve energy efficiency and economics of the microgrid. This paper considered the configurable energy source such as energy storage power station and demand response on the distribution network. Coordinated scheduling of multi-microgrids with intelligent management of active distribution network, and the master-slave differential game model of multi-time scale supply and demand interaction considering demand response is established. Finally, the paper analysed the process of master-slave differential game in active distribution network, the simulation results verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Dynamic economic dispatch solution considering wind speed dependence of multiple wind farms
abstract: With rapid growth of large-scale wind power integration, the impacts of modelling spatial dependence of nearby wind farms on power system optimal operation and security management require much more in-depth analysis. In this paper, dynamic economic dispatch (DED) problem considering wind speed dependence of multiple wind farms is solved, aiming at minimizing the total fuel costs and penalty costs involving generator regulation, load shedding and wind curtailment, subject to a series of system operating constraints. The dependence of high dimensional wind speed is described by copula theory. By comparing various copula functions, the optimal copula will be chosen to describe the correlation of high dimensional wind speed. For the solution of the DED problem, the scenario-based method is applied to describe wind power uncertainty and the scenario-based DED model is established. The simulations are tested on the IEEE-30 bus system to illustrate the validity and effectiveness of the established model and method.

articleTitle: Review of abnormal data identification and correction techniques in active distribution networks
abstract: With the rapid development of telecommunication and manufacturing technologies, advanced measurement devices, such as micro phasor measurement units and advanced metering infrastructures, have been increasing applied in active distribution networks to improve their observability and controllability. In the big data era of electric power, accurate data collection is essential to senior applications such as state estimation and fault diagnosis. However, the existence of abnormal data is inevitable due to many factors including communication delay, data loss and cyber-attacks etc, causing the abnormal data identification and correction to be a hot research topic. Considering a great variety of data identification and correction techniques have been proposed with different performance, this study presents a thorough review on these existing techniques. Firstly, the classification and causes of abnormal data are introduced; then popular abnormal data identification and correction methods are compared in details and summarized; on this basis, some potentially key research directions about data identification and correction are suggested.

articleTitle: Low-carbon power system economic dispatch considering renewable energy accommodation
abstract: In recent years, the problems of the energy crisis, environmental pollution, and global warming have provided good opportunities for the development of renewable energy. At the same time, the large-scale introduction of variable and limitedly predictable renewable energy also brings in huge challenges for the economic dispatch of the integrated electricity and natural gas system (IEGS). Thus, a stochastic low-carbon economic dispatch model (SLCED) with carbon capture power plants (CCPPs) and Power-to-gas (P2G) units is presented in this paper. The mathematical models of CCPPs and P2G units are reviewed first. Then, the operation mechanism of the low-carbon system with CCPPs and P2G is analysed. To increase the accommodation of renewable energy and control the carbon-emission-related costs, a comprehensive SLCED model is formulated, in which wind power uncertainties are modelled as weighted scenarios and the carbon emissions of power plants are treated as a new set of decision variables. The effectiveness and the validity of the proposed SLCED model are verified using numerical examples based on an IEEE 24-bus and 20-node gas network integrated test system.

articleTitle: Analysis of prefilter phase-locked loop under inter-harmonics perturbation
abstract: The accurate extraction of fundamental frequency and phase in grid voltage is important to ensure stable operation for Voltage Source Converter(VSC). Given inter-harmonics perturbation imposed on grid voltage, low-frequency deviation will be created in the phase-locked loop (PLL), and the output of PLL will include phase error. This paper presents a new PLL by serving Second Order Generalized Integrator (SOGI) as the prefilter in three-phase system, and the mirror frequency response of PLL under perturbation is analysed. Conventional PLL with its linearized model is shown to derive the output phase error of PLL under perturbation which includes mirror frequency. Frequency response of SOGI is given and the influence of prefilter is revealed in the frequency domain. The results indicate that bandwidth of PLL and the parameter of prefilter can both affect the accuracy of phase extraction in the inter-harmonics perturbation system considering mirror frequency. Performance of the prefilter PLL is evaluated by using Fast Fourier Transformation (FFT) spectrum analysis on the experiment platform to show its capability for disturbance rejection.

articleTitle: Research on voltage stabilityand optimal operation of DC microgrid
abstract: At present, in the distribution network consisting of DC power sources such as PV array, energy storage systems (ESS), data centers and charging, it is an ideal way to select a DC distribution network or a DC microgrid. This paper first establishes a model of DC microgrid consisting of PV array, direct-drive wind turbine generators, ESS and DC load, where PV array and direct drive wind turbines generators operate in MPPT control mode and ESS use improved droop control method. Ensure that the DC microgrid is rapidly entering a new stable point when the load or renewable energy resources (RES) input is constantly changing, so that the microgrid remains stable within a certain range. On the basis of voltage stability, the relationship between the MPPT curve of RES and the sagging characteristics of ESS is studied. The optimal control method of RES and ESS is adopted to appropriately change the operating characteristics of RES and it is no longer mandatory to operate at MPPT. Instead, run near this point to ensure optimal operation of the grid. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the improved energy storage droop control mode and combined optimal control mode of RES and ESS.

articleTitle: Design of control and protection system for medium-low voltage flexible DC distribution network
abstract: With the wide application of distributed generation, DC load and power electronic equipment, DC distribution network has attracted more and more attention. After the establishment of DC distribution network, higher requirements are put forward for fault detection, protection of DC distribution lines and coordinated control between devices. Based on the analysis of the primary system such as grid structure, grounding mode and DC switches configuration scheme, the control structure and protection zoning scheme of flexible DC system are given in this paper to realize fast isolation of DC side faults. On this basis, a coordinated control scheme including DC system fault detection, fault isolation and fault recovery is proposed to analyse action sequence and time limit of each device under closed loop operation and separate operation of converter valve. Beside this, this paper also gives the power system recovery sequence diagram. This control strategy effectively shortens the power supply recovery time and has practical engineering value.

articleTitle: An evaluation method of feeder automation for distribution network considering distributed generation
abstract: The accuracy and precision of automation action in feeder automation (FA) system are important factors to ensure the reliability of distribution network. Wide access of distributed generation (DG) introduces a new challenge to the traditional FA evaluation method. Given this background, this paper presents an evaluation method of the FA for distribution network considering DGs. Firstly, the load states during the fault location, isolation and restoration process are elaborately defined and the affecting factors of FA are systematically researched. Secondly, the evaluation indexes of FA with DGs are proposed, including seven evaluation indexes from two aspects of action process and action result, respectively. Subsequently, the comprehensive evaluation method of the action effectiveness for the FA with DGs in the distribution network is improved based on the failure-free evaluation test method. Finally, a FA system with double loop network is employed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation method.

articleTitle: Analysis of traveling wave front and its application in fault location
abstract: The operating environment of the high voltage dc (HVDC) transmission lines is more complex than that of the ac lines, thus the dc transmission lines have higher probability of faults. Fast and accurate fault location can ensure the safe operation of the dc power grid, which has great social and economic benefits. However, single-ended traveling wave fault location method has the problem of inaccurate discrimination and calibration of the reflected wave as well as wave velocity uncertainty, and the fault analysis method is subject to line model. In this paper, the expression of the fault traveling wave front in time domain is deduced based on the frequency-dependent characteristic of the dc transmission lines and the propagation function approximation. The obtained expression is related to the fault distance. Then a basic fitting function (BFF) of the same form as the traveling wave front expression is selected to fit the actual measured traveling wave front. When a fault occurs, solving the equations of the obtained fitting parameters and the fault distance can locate the fault. The simulation results show that the proposed fault location method can fast and correctly locate the fault in the dc transmission lines, with the attribute of anti-fault-impedance.

articleTitle: Decentralized unified control strategy for medium and low voltage DC distribution power system
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic (PV) accessed to DC distribution power system (DPS) from multi-port is a major form to promote the consumption of renewable energy, but the increase of PV permeability will lead to the deterioration of the system stability. Traditional analysis usually concentrates on the DC micro-grid and the analysis of DC DPS with multi-voltage levels, such as medium and low voltage DC DPS, is rarely involved. This paper proposes a decentralized unified control strategy for the medium and low voltage DC DPS. It is composed of two parts, one is the decentralized control strategy based on the DC bus voltage signal (DBS) for the PV, storage and fuel cell units on the DC bus; one is the unified control strategy for the DC transformer integrating the power control, medium voltage and low voltage DC bus voltage regulation functions. Consequently, it avoids the control mode switching of DC transformer and can achieve the global power sharing of the system. Finally, the equivalent simulation model of medium and low voltage DC DPS is built in Matlab/Simulink and simulation analysis of multiple operating states and scenarios is carried out to validate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

Author Keywords: MEDIUM ANL LOW VOLTAGE DC DPS

articleTitle: Fault characteristics analysis of DC distribution network based on power electronic transformer
abstract: In recent years, power electronic transformer (PET) that can realize various functions such as voltage transformation, electrical isolation, power regulation and control, and new energy access has been gradually applied in DC distribution networks as a new type of converter. The power electronic transformer's structure is different from that of the traditional voltage source converter, the fault characteristics no longer meet the three-stage characteristics. Therefore, it is necessary to study the fault characteristics of the power electronic transformer. Based on the Suzhou Tongli DC distribution network project, a multi-port power electronic transformer (AC10kV/DC±750V/DC±375V) is established in this paper. The fault characteristics of the two DC ports is analysed respectively. The PSCAD simulation results verify the accuracy of the analysis result of fault characteristics.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of electrical oscillation existing in grid integration of PMSG-based wind farm with VSC-HVDC system
abstract: Compared with the traditional sub/super-synchronous oscillation in grid-connected permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG)-based wind farm, a new type of electrical oscillation which over the super-synchronous frequency region may also occur in the grid integration of PMSGs through voltage source converter based HVDC (VSC-HVDC) system, which is worthy of further study. In this paper, the positive sequence impedance models both of PMSG-based wind farm and the wind farm VSC (WFVSC) station are established. Then the equivalent impedance model of the whole system can be further represented. The analysis results show that PMSG represents as a negative resistance in series with a capacitance at the resonant frequency point, while WFVSC represents as a resistance-inductance. Thus, the electrical oscillation tends to appear due to the negative damping effect of PMSG. Furthermore, this paper studies the influence of PI controllers' parameters of grid-side converter (GSC) of PMSG and WFVSC on the characteristics of the oscillation. In addition, the impact of the operating condition such as the output power level of PMSG on the oscillation characteristics are analysed as well. Finally, the correctness of the analysis results is validated by time-domain simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective distribution network reconfiguration with DG integration using improved fireworks algorithm
abstract: The network integration of distributed generation (DG) units such as wind turbines and photovoltaic (PV) energy systems makes distribution system operation and control more complicated while achieving economic and environmental benefits. This paper presents a multi-objective distribution network reconfiguration optimization model incorporating wind and PV components, aiming at minimizing system power loss, voltage nodes deviation, and load balance under a series of specific operational constraints. The scenario-based analysis technique is introduced to handle the uncertainties of wind turbine generation and PV output. Regarding the highly nonlinear nature of the proposed model, an enhanced fireworks algorithm is applied to obtain the set of Pareto front solutions of the multi-objective optimization model. Some significant improvement measures including improved loop coding to avoid infeasible solution, flexible adjustment of optimal radius pertinent to the Pareto front according to the population algebra and the individual dominant strength are discussed elaborately during analysis. Finally, the case studies are carried out on the IEEE 33-bus test system. The corresponding statistical analysis pertinent to different DG output scenarios and the comparative analysis are elaborately designed and conducted to demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed model and enhanced method.

articleTitle: Combined heat and power economic dispatch solution incorporating wind power uncertainty
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power integration, the curtailment issue for wind power has aroused wide concern around the world. In particular, the operating principle of "power determined by heat" widely applied by conventional combined heat and power (CHP) units makes the wind power curtailment more severe. How to effectively tackle the power-heat coupling to enhance wind power accommodation is still one of the difficult problems to be solved in smart grid. This paper proposes a CHP economic dispatch (ED) solution considering wind power uncertainty, aiming at minimizing the total fuel cost of generation while meeting a series of system operating constraints. A power-heat decoupling scheme with utilization of electric boilers is designed to reduce wind curtailment while meeting thermal and electrical loads. Furthermore, the scenario-based analysis method is applied to deal with the wind power uncertainty during analysis. Owing to the highly nonlinear characteristic of the proposed CHP ED optimization model, an improved cuckoo search algorithm is utilized to solve the problem, and the coordinated scheduling strategy combined with the wind power uncertainty is formulated elaborately. Finally, the effectiveness and validity of the proposed model and strategy are simulated and tested on IEEE 30-bus test system.

articleTitle: Adjustable robust optimal power flow considering random output of various renewable energy integration in complex three-phase distribution networks
abstract: With the uncertainty of the output of renewable energy, a large number of access brings a great challenge to the planning and operation of distribution network. Optimal Power Flow Considering Random Output of Distributed Generation (DG) has become an important research topic in distribution network operation. This paper proposed a robust optimization model of optimal power flow in three-phase distribution network and random distributed power output. Using the dual norm theory to Transforming Uncertain Model into Deterministic Model for Solving. Aiming at the program that the robust optimization problem is too conservation, the economy and security of the coordinated mediation are guaranteed by adjusting the uncertainty. The simulation results of three-phase distribution system with IEEE-13 and IEEE-123 nodes show that compared with deterministic model and stochastic optimization model, The proposed adjustable robust optimal power flow model takes into account the uncertainties of renewable energy sources, has good robustness and high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Vibration signature of direct-drive wind turbine under converter open-switch fault
abstract: Previous research on wind turbine (WT) reliability has found that electronic components, such as converters, of a wind turbine has relatively high failure rate. Therefore, the fault diagnosis and tolerance control of converters is crucial for WT to improve the reliability. For open-switch fault of a machine side converter, the existing fault detection methods mainly rely on electrical signals, such as three-phase AC current/voltage, DC-link voltage etc. It is sensible the failures on converters will also lead to the fluctuation of generator speed and then increasing vibrations. In this paper, vibration signature of PMSM under the condition of open-switch fault in direct-drive WT converters are studied through simulations and experiments. And a diagnostic approach based on vibration signals is proposed and tested with experimental data. From the enveloped spectrum of vibration signals, it is found the characteristic frequency of open-switch fault equals the number of pole pair multiplied by the rotational frequency. By combining encoder signal and vibration signal, the faulty switch can be located via the periodic impact of vibration in time domain.

articleTitle: Angular sampling of wind turbine low-speed shaft using high-resolution magnetic keyphasor
abstract: Precise angular measurement of low-speed shaft is important for condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of Wind Turbine (WT) drivetrain operating at low speed. A high-resolution keyphase device, consisting of a magnetic grid and a magneto-resistance sensor, is proposed to measure the rotating angles of WT low-speed shaft. A flexible magnetic grid was attached around main shaft tracked with an anisotropic magnetoresistance (AMR) sensor whose acquisition frequency beyond several hundred kHz. Firstly, the measurement system can generate micron-scale pulses in equal angle and instantaneous angular speed (IAS) can be easily obtained from counting these pulses. Furthermore, the high-resolution magnetic keyphasor is used as a trigger source for vibration signal acquisition. Therefore, order spectrum of low-speed drivetrain vibration can be easily constructed based on Fourier transform of the acquired vibration signals. Design of measurement system is introduced in details and experimental results are shown to prove the concept. The designed device, with high resolution and high stability, is easy to install on site. The proposed angular measurement system facilitates not only reliable IAS measurement, but also better fault diagnosis of WT drivetrain.

articleTitle: Individual pitch control strategy for a low wind speed wind turbine
abstract: Low wind speed areas have certain advantages over high wind speed areas for electricity generation because they are closer to the urban electrical grid and the transport and installation costs are lower. The diameter of low wind speed wind turbines is larger and the unbalanced load caused by wind shear is a larger problem than in high wind speed turbines. In order to improve the output power performance and prolong the lifetime of the turbines, an independent pitch control (IPC) strategy is implemented by integrating the software GH Bladed and MATLAB. Interactive software is designed based on the named pipeline method to achieve a joint simulation of GH Bladed and MATLAB. According to the blade root load and the blade azimuth angle, the outside bending torque component in the fixed hub coordinate system is obtained using the Park transformation and the deviation of the three pitch angles of the individual control is obtained by using a fuzzy proportional-integral (PI) control strategy and the inverse Park transformation. The results show that the IPC strategy provides a reduction in the unbalanced load of the wind turbines and provides more stable output power.

Author Keywords: Joint Simulation of GH Bladed and MATLAB

articleTitle: Negative resistance effect induced by network dynamics in power-electronic-based power systems: A simple case study
abstract: In the traditional power systems, power flow studies focus on the stationary relationship of the active and reactive powers versus bus voltage under the quasi-steady state approximation. With increasing penetration of power electronics devices including renewable generations interfaced through converters, the system dynamical behaviour changes substantially. Due to the fast dynamics of converters, such as the AC current controller, the quasi-stationary state approximation may not be applicable. In order to catch the network characteristics accurately, we derive the explicit small-signal relation between instantaneous power and voltage vectors. Further, we study a simple power system model, which includes a network equation considering dynamics relationship and a swing equation. The numerical and analytical results demonstrate a novel negative resistance effect induced by generators on network dynamics. This effect may be weak for the traditional power systems, however, it may become significant for the new-generation power-electronic-based power systems.

articleTitle: Sub-synchronous oscillation(SSO) analysis of direct-driven permanent magnet synchronous generators(D-PMSG)considering influence of phase-locked loop(PLL)
abstract: Since the phase-locked loop (PLL) synchronizes the frequency and phase of the wind turbine and the power grid, realizing the coupling between them, so its dynamic performance directly affects the transient characteristics of the wind turbine. In this paper, the mechanism of sub-synchronous oscillation ( SSO ) caused by direct-driven permanent magnet synchronous generators(D-PMSG) transmission system is studied, and the electromagnetic transient model of D-PMSG converter with PLL control is established by the harmonic linearization method. The influence of the dynamic characteristics of PLL on SSO caused by D-PMSG and the interaction between D-PMSG and connected power grid are studied. Finally, the critical conditions of SSO induced by D-PMSG are given by using the Nyquist criterion. Finally, D-PMSG delivery model based on Hami local power grid is built by PSCAD software. The detailed model of the D-PMSG transient system was established by using the PSCAD. The theoretical analysis of the proposed SSO are validated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on the control strategy of energy storage system in photovoltaic power station
abstract: With the large development and utilization of renewable energy, the penetration of photovoltaic power will be significantly increased in the future. But the high photovoltaic power penetration will make effects on the safe and stable operation of the system, especially reflected in terms of frequency. The deployment of fast response plant, principally energy storage system, is currently considered necessary to mitigate reduced system inertia and increased frequency change. In this paper, a photovoltaic-storage cooperative primary frequency regulation (PFR) control strategy is put forward. The centralized energy storage system is deployed in photovoltaic power station. When the frequency of the power grid exceeds the dead zone of PFR, the energy storage system quickly adjusts output to respond to system frequency change, then the centralized control system of photovoltaic power station adjusts photovoltaic output to respond to the frequency change of system and replaces the power of energy storage system participating in the frequency regulation of the system. The control strategy can not only improve the response speed of PFR of photovoltaic power stations, but also reduce the allocation capacity requirements of energy storage and SOC changes.

articleTitle: Multi-objective siting and sizing of distributed generation based on the mixed integer second-order cone programming
abstract: The multi-objective model of distribution generation (DG) siting and sizing is proposed. The objectives consist of 1) minimizing the investment and operation and maintenance cost; 2) minimizing the total active power loss of the system. The proposed model is transferred to Second-Order Cone Programming (SOCP) model based on backward forward sweep-based power flow and constraint relaxation. The CVX platform and GUROBI solver are used for the solution. The Normal Boundary Intersection (NBI) method is used for the multi-objective model in order to obtain the well distributed Pareto front solution, the result is compared with the solution from Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA-II). The proposed model and methodology are verified with IEEE 33 example.

articleTitle: Power system fault chain simulation model considering the effect of geomagnetic storm
abstract: In the condition of strong geomagnetic storm, geo-magnetically induced current (GIC) flowing through the neutral point of the transformer, causing the increase of reactive power loss, which leads to overload of the reactive power compensation devices, drop of the bus voltage and occurrence of a chain fault, which in turn causes a blackout. Comparing the characteristics of each link in the fault chain and the development law of the blackout caused by geomagnetic storms, the fault chain model is used to simulate the process of power outage under conditions of geomagnetic storm. The paper determines the propagation path of cascading failures based on the self-organizing critical theory and the safety margin of non-faulty circuits. Combining with IEEE-RTS 79 system parameters, the geo-location of each bus is estimated. Simulating by PowerWorld software, the research results verify that the proposed model can reflect the geomagnetic storm parameters against the power system fault chains and the identification of weak links under given grid conditions. The research results can provide basis for quantifying and preventing geomagnetic storm grid disasters.

articleTitle: A fitted model predictive control approach for real-time policy making of microgrid energy system
abstract: The model predictive control (MPC) approaches attracted attention of the power system operators due to its feature of reducing the effect of forecast errors on microgrid real-time operation and optimization. The multi-time scale demand response dispatch framework based on fitted-MPC approach is proposed for reducing the effect of forecast errors and ensuring enough ramping capability for participating short-term electricity market. In the day-ahead optimal economic dispatch model, the operation cost and demand response compensation income of microgrid are considered. In the intra-day rolling optimal economic dispatch model, the adjustable capacity factor (ACF) is introduced to make a trade-off between the effect of power control and ramping capability. Finally, a real microgrid system is used to prove the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method. The results of cases show that microgrid can effectively participate short-term demand response markets under the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Application of MMC based on state observer in DC integration of renewable energy
abstract: MMC will become the most forward-looking multi-level topology with its many advantages in the field of DC transmission and renewable energy integration. In MMC operation, its controller requires separated feedback voltages for all sub-modules, where communication systems and capacitor voltage sensors are required, and as the number of modules increases, the complexity of the control system increases. Moreover, due to the increase in voltage sensors, the cost of the control system has increased. In this paper, a controller is proposed to achieve voltage balance of each module and phase leg by eliminating the voltage feedback based on the reduced order state observer. First, the model of MMC is analysed in detail, and the voltage balance problem is elaborated. Then, a reduced-order observer based on equivalent model is proposed for sub-module voltage estimation, and a sub-module open-loop controller for MMC is proposed. The parameter sensitivity analysis and steady state error of the state observer are also given. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed controller are verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: The influence of wind/PV generation uncertainties on power system low frequency oscillation
abstract: In recent years, the integration of large-scale wind/Photovoltaic (PV) generation with inherent uncertainties has played a vital role in the stability of modern power system, especially in the low frequency oscillation (LFO) regarding weather changes. This paper aims to conduct the LFO analysis when wind farm and PV power station are integrated into the existing power system. Based on eigenvalue analysis, the small signal analysis models of the Doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) type wind farm and the PV station are built. The low frequency oscillation characteristics of the multi-machine power system with integration of wind farm equipped with PMSG and PV power station are elaborately studied under the Matlab™ environment. In addition, the influence on LFO modes is investigated in depth when the wind speed and light intensity fluctuate independently. In particular, a multivariate probability distribution of wind speed and light intensity is applied to simulate the real conditions of the multi-machine system incorporating wind/PV generation. The Monte Carlo simulation technique based probabilistic small signal stability analysis is conducted to explore and exploit the impacts on the LFO stability. Some meaningful conclusions and comments are obtained by studying the damping ratios of the system.

articleTitle: Harmonic current assessment method for wind farm excluding background harmonics
abstract: Accurate calculating harmonic currents of the wind farm without the influence of background harmonics, is a hot and difficult issue in the field of wind farm testing. The key point of excluding background harmonic influence is to determine the harmonic impedance on both sides of the point of interconnection (POI) of wind farm. A new method for calculating the harmonic impedance on both sides of POI was proposed. Firstly, a set of Zs and Zc is obtained from several testing data based on Complex Independent Component Method, and Zs and Zc are harmonic impedance of grid side and wind farm side, respectively. Then, these harmonic impedance values are filtered by Complex Linear Regression method. The final Zs and Zc are obtained by 95% probability method. The harmonic current from grid side and wind farm side can be calculated by Norton equivalent circuit model at the POI. The simulation results show that the harmonic impedance values calculated after impedance screening are more accurate. This method can effectively eliminate the influence of background harmonic and accurately obtain the harmonic current of the wind farm, and provide an accurate basis for the harmonic characteristics evaluation and harmonic control of the wind farm.

articleTitle: Study on angle stability and critical penetration of power system with high proportion wind power
abstract: Under the policy of sustainable development, the growth of renewable energy penetration is the inevitable trend of power system development in the future. It will fundamentally change the structure of power grid. The stable operation of renewable energy power system is one of the major challenges. For the ultra-high penetration renewable energy power grid, there is no clear conclusion that the renewable energy grid-connected through power electronics has a positive or negative impact on power system angle stability. And there is no a exact critical penetration of wind which should be connected. Firstly, based on the power characteristics of wind turbines, an equivalent impedance model of wind turbines is established. Then the angle stability and transmission power characteristics of three-machine system under different wind power penetration is analyzed, and limit penetration of wind power subject to static angle stability is proposed. A case study applies and verifies above theories. Finally, the influence of transmission lines and reactive power characteristics of wind turbines on system stability is analyzed, and the guiding measures to improve system stability are put forward.

articleTitle: Power control performance evaluation of wind turbine based on a hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform
abstract: Power control performance evaluation of wind turbine can offer an important guarantee for reliable operation of power grid. Modelling is a general method to study the power control strategy. However, the power control performance of wind turbine is evaluated based on field test at present, because accurate results of power control test are not easy to be obtained by simulation. Combined simulation method in off-line simulation has been used with the consideration of coupling effect of electrical and mechanical components, but the dynamical behaviour in a long period of time cannot be investigated because of the low efficiency of solver. In the electromagnetic transient research of power electronics, real-time simulation is suggested with high efficiency. In this paper, a hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation method for the power-control capability evaluation of wind turbine is proposed. Physical controllers in the HIL include main controller and converter controller. Multi-time step of detailed model simulation was realized by different types of interface based on real-time simulators. Additionally, an experiment on power control of wind turbine was carried out. It is a convenient and time-saving way to evaluate the power control performance of wind turbine in the HIL simulation platform.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive evaluation of distribution network considering resilience
abstract: With the development of smart distribution network, distributed energy and diversified load are more and more involved in distribution network planning and operation. Their characteristics of ‘both power and load’ should be emphasized. These make power restoration in extreme weather conditions possible, and meanwhile, make the evaluation of high-reliability distribution network more difficult. A comprehensive evaluation method of distribution network considering resilience is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a new evaluation index system is established under the background of distribution network resilience research. Secondly, based on K-means clustering method, the evaluation criteria considering huge regional differences in China are proposed. Thirdly, the scientific weights of evaluation indices are determined based on the variation coefficient method. Finally, an actual distribution network in eastern China was evaluated as an example. Case analysis shows that the evaluation index system proposed in this paper is effective and could reasonably indicate the comprehensive performance of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Study on the method of grid planning on Space-time distribution of power system frequency
abstract: With the construction of UHV grid, the tightness of AC / DC hybrid power network is improved, and the space-time distribution characteristics of frequency response will also change, which will have an impact on the operation of the system. The traditional transmission grids planning only considers the engineering cost, short-circuit current and economical operation of the transmission grid, and lacks the restriction based on the time-space distribution of frequency. In this paper, a grid planning method based on frequency space-time distribution is presented. According to the influence of network structure on frequency space-time distribution, the evaluation index is defined by the characteristics of frequency space-time distribution, and the proposed route planning scheme is evaluated, so as to carry out the optimal route planning scheme.

articleTitle: A data-driven method for detection and localization of weak fault based on synchronized phasor measurements
abstract: Weak fault detection and localization have been a major concern in power grid for a long time. Existing methods are usually model-based, and extracting fault characteristics by frequency domain signal analysis, which are difficult to cover a variety of situations. And when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is low, the success rate cannot be guaranteed. Based on the widespread synchronized phasor measurements, a model-free data-driven method is proposed to address these issues. From the point of view of statistical characters, the M-P law is used to filter the abnormal eigenvalues of the matrix formed by raw data of a power grid, which is the key to extract features of weak fault without modeling. Furthermore, the SNR is improved by the correlation analysis of the matrix elements. With the use of split window, the method is able to monitor power grid in real time, and can eliminate random errors by considering the width of the window. The case studies, using both 80-node simulated network and real distribution network, validate that the proposed method is sensitive and universal to different scenarios.

articleTitle: Islanded large scale wind power integration based on LCC-HVDC and STATCOM
abstract: Compared to VSC (Voltage Source Converter) HVDC, traditional LCC (Line Commutated Converter) HVDC has higher reliability and a considerably higher DC current capability. Therefore, LCC-HVDC is more suitable for long distance transmission of large scale renewable energy. However, for grid-integrating a large wind cluster that has no AC power system connection, the system is very difficult to work properly. Any active power imbalance between LCC HVDC and wind farm will cause severe frequency stability problem. Additionally, LCC HVDC requires a strong voltage and reactive support from the ac system, and the wind farm also needs a certain degree of voltage and reactive support from the ac system. In the absence of ac system support, the voltage stability problem is remarkable. The configuration of VSC-based STATCOM is a potential way to solve those problems. This paper investigates the main principles and effective control strategies for islanded large scale wind power integration based on LCC HVDC and STATCOM.

articleTitle: The optimal operation of power-heat-gas system with storage and wind generation
abstract: With the significant growth of the power-heat-gas system (PHGS), more efforts are urgently required to better improve the operation flexibility and coordinate the various energy in the PHGS. In this case, firstly, storage facilities are applied to promote the flexibility of PHGS, i.e. reduce wind curtailment and make peak shaving. Then, in order to capture the wind power uncertainties, given in the optimization objective, the wind power range is introduced in an economic way. Note that based on the electric power storage, the realizable acceptance range of the fluctuant wind is given with wind probability information. Finally, the numerical results demonstrate that the storage facilities integrated into energy coordination can significantly affect the energy coordination in the PHGS, besides verifying the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Isolated microgrid voltage regulation using fuzzy-logic based inverter control
abstract: Modern isolated microgrid requires flexible and intelligent control of inverter to minimize the power mismatch between renewable generators and load. Maintaining the voltage at load connection is one of the critical aspects of voltage regulation in the isolated microgrid. The power generation from renewable generators is not constant as well as load parameters. Also, the power flow control between renewable generators is another major issue in an isolated microgrid. In this study, the intelligent fuzzy-logic based inverter control (FLIC) is used to regulate the voltage at the load connected considered the change in load-parameter and variation in the renewable power generation. The power output from the renewable generators is converted in DC to make the DC-bus, which helps to maintain the power flow control between renewable generators and battery storage. The variation in the DC bus voltage is kept within acceptable limit using PI battery controller. The FLIC uses the error in the reference voltage and difference between the line-to-line voltage to generate firing pulses based on if-then rules. PV and renewable wind generator modeled with MPPT control for optimal power generation.

articleTitle: Study on reactive voltage regulation and optimal control strategy of PV power station considering energy storage system
abstract: Most of the photovoltaic (PV) power plants in operation are equipped with a certain proportion of Static VAR Generator (SVG). The reactive power and voltage control system in PV power station achieves the control objectives of the dispatching mechanism by controlling SVG, without considering the reactive power and voltage regulation ability of the inverters themselves. To better exert the reactive power and voltage support ability of the PV inverters, reduce the SVG system investment and later O&M costs. It is necessary to introduce new voltage regulation methods. This paper focused on a hybrid reactive voltage regulation, method and control strategy based on energy storage system and PV inverters. By combine the good response characteristics of energy storage battery and optimizing the configuration and coordination control, it can not only respond to the second-level steady-state reactive power demand of PV power station, but also respond to the millisecond-level reactive power demand. The ability of second-order transient voltage fluctuation was verified by the example of Luneng Haixi Demonstration Project, which satisfies the power system requirements for ability and speed of reactive power regulation, and plays a role in replacing SVG to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Partial discharge analysis of insulators in transmission lines in coastal heavy pollution areas
abstract: Composite insulators can effectively prevent grid flashovers. They are widely used in overhead transmission lines. The operational reliability of composite insulators directly affects the safe and stable operation of the power grid. This paper introduces the partial discharge phenomenon of composite insulators in the heavy pollution environment of coastal areas. Infrared and ultraviolet detection tests were performed on site. A series of tests such as mechanical load tensile test and component analysis were performed in the laboratory. Based on the results of these tests, the causes of this partial discharge were analyzed and corresponding prevention measures were proposed.

articleTitle: DC grid based on hybrid MMC and fast vacuum switch
abstract: VSC-HVDC transmission grid with overhead lines has a good application prospect in the transmission and grid-connection of large-scale wind power and other renewable energy. Due to the rapid rise of DC current under DC line fault, DC circuit breaker with high speed and large capacity is generally used to isolate DC faults in the VSC-HVDC engineering. However, the manufacture of DC circuit breaker is difficult and costly, hindering the development of the DC power grid. So, the VSC-HVDC transmission grid based on hybrid MMC and fast vacuum switch is proposed. It makes full use of the control ability of hybrid MMC, proposing an active current limiting control strategy. The VSC-HVDC transmission grid can be switched to a new steady state quickly and flexibly. The power interruption time of the DC grid is shortened, which can improve the utilization of the DC grid. At the same time, the fast vacuum switches are installed in the DC line to replace the high-speed large-capacity DC circuit breaker, to reduce the construction cost of the DC power grid. Finally, simulations based on the PSCAD/EMTDC platform are executed to verify the correctness of this method.

articleTitle: Wind farm active voltage regulation strategy of transient support improvement
abstract: The cumulative installed capacity of wind power worldwide has grown rapidly in recent years. Fixed reactive power control is adopted by wind turbines (WTs) to receive cycle instruction of wind farm (WF) automatic voltage control system (AVCS). It does not have active voltage regulation (AVR) capability, which reduces the reliability of power system operation. Firstly, two ways of WTs AVR which QV droop control and Vac control mode are introduced in this paper. On the basis, the problems of reactive power circulation and control points inconsistency during multi-WTs voltage regulation are discussed. The problems are solved by coordination of WTs of WF AVR strategy. WF voltage transient support capability is promoted by the strategy. Effectiveness is verified by simulation case of the proposed method.

articleTitle: State classification of transformer in the renewable power grid based on principal component analysis and support vector machine evaluation system
abstract: With the development of big data mining and analysis in the field of renewable power system, the renewable power grid is moving towards the direction of intelligence, informatization and networking. In this trend, considering the complexity of state evaluation, this paper adopts principal component analysis (PCA) to conduct dimensionality reduction processing for the numerous state data, eliminate the correlation between data and select the most valuable key parameters, thus reducing the complexity of subsequent calculation. Then, LS-SVM is used as the classifier, the key parameters mentioned above are taken as input, and particle swarm optimization is used for parameter optimization to evaluate the state level of the transformer. At the same time, a multistage SVM system is proposed to solve the problem of SVM one-to-many classification, and a transformer state evaluation model is established. The research results will lay the foundation for the application of big data technology and artificial intelligence technology in the field of state assessment of substation equipment in the renewable power grid.

articleTitle: The restricted operation scenario screening strategy of distributed power based on shadow price
abstract: In recent years, a large number of new elements such as distributed power, energy storage, and electric vehicles have been added to the distribution network, which enrich the operation scenario of the distribution network and result in more uncertain of the distribution network operation. In order to adapt to various distribution network operation scenarios and improve the ability of renewable energy consumption, this paper fully considers the various uncertainties of active distribution network, and establishes a quantitative analysis model of distributed power restriction. This paper proposes a restricted operation scenario screening strategy of distributed power based on shadow price by correcting the shadow price of network resources of the scheduling operation optimization model. Through this strategy, a set of restricted operation scenarios is obtained, and the screening results are incorporated into distributed power planning. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy and model is verified by an extended IEEE33 node example.

articleTitle: Research on peak-cutting and filling technology based on flexible interconnected distribution network
abstract: The imbalance of the load rate of each partition of the traditional distribution network and the large peak-to-valley difference of the load curve are the difficult problems to be solved in the optimization of the distribution network. The multi-terminal flexible interconnected distribution network can realize power interaction and power mutual support between the AC systems based on the DC power distribution center, which provides the possibility of multi-end load optimization. In order to fully consider the multi-objective optimization problem of economic benefits such as Peak Load Shifting optimization in flexible interconnected power distribution networks, this paper proposes a research on Peak Load Shifting optimization technology based on flexible interconnected power distribution network. Aiming at the effect of Peak Load Shifting, and the economics of time-sharing electricity price, a multi-objective optimization model of Peak Load Shifting based on flexible distribution network based on energy storage system was constructed. Considering the difference in the dimensions of the sub-objective functions, the multi-objective problem is optimized by adjusting the dimension function of the sub-objects to the dimensionless function through the normalization idea. Finally, the improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to quickly find the Pareto optimal frontier surface, and the optimal scheme is selected in the Pareto frontier by fuzzy set theory.

articleTitle: A novel method in classifying and analysing faults in renewable energy power transformers
abstract: Large scale renewable grids like PV (Photovoltaic) power plants use Power transformers which are considered a major player in the field of renewable energy, it plays an important role in the system by stepping up the output voltage of the PV system inverter and supply it to the grid. Thus, it is pivotal to provide the necessary maintenance and diagnostic procedures to it. This paper explains a new and effective method for analysing and classifying faults in a power transformer. It starts by pre-processing the sampled data by using Z-score normalization method and putting the pre-processed results into Sigmoid function to eliminate noise, outliers and increase accuracy. Then the data is inputted to the neural networks Self-organizing map to obtain the number of clusters and the results are used as an input to the unsupervised clustering algorithm based fuzzy C-means method for classifying the faults. Validation of the proposed approach has been accomplished by examining sampled data via DGA (Dissolved Gas Analysis) technique which is obtained from Zibo electrical power company. By comparing the results of the proposed method and the traditional methods; it is found that the new method obtains a remarkable performance in classifying transformer faults.

articleTitle: Transient response of DC fault and fault current-limiting strategy of hybrid three-terminal HVDC transmission system
abstract: The hybrid multi-terminal UHVDC transmission system combines the advantages of line commutated converter (LCC) and modular multilevel converter (MMC), which has become the most competitive candidate in future power systems for bulk power transmission. Based on the topology of three-terminal HVDC system, the DC fault characteristics is proposed. Based on the model in PSCAD/EMTDC, the fault characteristics of pole-to-ground of the system at different fault positions and different transient resistance are analyzed. Then, the fast fault current suppression strategy based on DC inductance and additional current feed-ward control strategy of hybrid MMC are proposed. Finally, the simulation results of PSCAD/EMTDC show that the improved control strategy can effectively suppress the fault current produced by the converters.

articleTitle: Generation-grid-storage coordinated planning method with renewable portfolio standard
abstract: The key to fulfill the quota is to consider the renewable energy accommodation in the planning stage of power system with renewables portfolio standards. Based on the renewable energy quota index, this paper proposes a coordinated planning method to improve the accommodation capacity of power system from three aspects: generation, grid and energy storage to complete the renewable energy quota index. In this method, using time series production simulation to characterize the time varying characteristics of renewable energy and load. Considering the uncertainty of renewable energy and dynamic operation constraints of power system, a two-stage robust optimization model satisfying the quota index of renewable energy is established. This model has a min-max-min structure and nonlinear constraints, which is reformulated into mixed integer linear programming (MILP) that can be solved by commercial software by using duality theory and Big-M method, and the uncertainty budget parameter are introduced to reduce the conservatism of the scheme. Finally, based on the example of IEEE RTS-24 node system, the influence of renewable energy quota index on the planning results is analyzed, and the effectiveness of the coordinated planning model is verified.

articleTitle: Study on voltage segment control strategy of large-scale renewable power base based on hierarchical-partitioned principle
abstract: Large-scale renewable power base collection system topology is complex. According to a single constant voltage control, prone to result in reactive power oscillation between different reactive power compensation equipments as some output and the others absorb. In this paper, based on hierarchical-partitioned principle, the renewable power base is divided into two reactive power and voltage control area: collection stations and renewable power station. Construct a reactive loss function with impedance and active power as variables, and characterize the trajectory of reactive loss with impedance and active power. The reactive power flow between two control areas and the allowable operating range of the bus voltage are restrained. The voltage of the collection station bus and the point of connection of renewable power station is taken as the control object. A voltage segment control strategy tracking renewable power output based on electrical topological impedance is proposed, to achieve reactive power voltage coordination control and improve reactive power voltage stability margin of the renewable power base. The simulation results of a renewable power base in the Three-North region of China verify effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of power generation performance for wind turbine based on entropy weight method and contingency theory
abstract: Assessing the performance of the wind turbine(WT) plays an important role in reducing operation and maintenance costs, optimizing maintenance strategies, and improving WT generating capacity. Accurate performance evaluation of the WT has become a research hotspot. Therefore, this paper proposes a performance evaluation model for the WT based on Entropy Weight Method(EWM) and Contingency Theory(CT). First, the wind speed and wind power pairs are cleaned by using the Optimal Interclass Variance-Kernel Density Estimation(OIV-KDE). Secondly, the indicators, normalized according to the concept of deterioration degree, are proposed and calculated to evaluate the power generation performance. Then, build a framework structure that reflects the power generation performance of the WT. Finally, according to the EWM and CT, the comprehensive weights are obtained to fuzzily evaluate the power generation performance of the WT. Based on the operation data of six 1.5MW wind turbines(WTs), the paper analyses the power generation performance evaluation results of WTs. The results show that the model is correct and effective.

Author Keywords: EVALUATION MODEL OF GENERATION PERFORMANCE FOR WIND POWER

articleTitle: Development of high frequency resistance test bench for high power fuel cell stack
abstract: The proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is considered to be the ultimate technical direction of vehicle power. Online water content diagnosis of PEMFC has become the basis for system control. With the commercial application of fuel cell, traditional electrochemical test instruments are incapable to meet the acquirements of power, voltage and current. As the fuel cell performance is mainly affected by the water content of membrane, HFR is more representative of the overall water content of the system. Meanwhile, high portability is an advantage in this test method. In this work, theory analysis and experiment are combined to realize effective online diagnosis of water content under the condition of small hardware modification. Through simulation and test, a high power fuel cell impedance monitor is designed and high frequency resistance (HFR) is selected as a diagnostic index of water content based on the characteristics of the PEMFC system. According to the experimental results, the boundary value of HFR as a fault diagnosis indicator for water state is determined and online monitoring of PEMFC water content is achieved by HFR.

articleTitle: Disaster recovery strategy of resilient distribution network based on scheduling coefficient
abstract: To enhance the disaster response and recovery capability of the distribution network when a power outage occurs, this paper proposes an optimal disaster recovery strategy under the source network load coordination mechanism. Since multiple renewable power generations integrate in the distribution network, the system flexibility and resilience become considerable. In order to apply these features better to improve the recovery ability, the scheduling process should be optimized. Thus, this paper proposes the concept of the "scheduling coefficient" to obtain the optimal schedule of the distribution network. Based on this virtual coefficient, the scheduling rationality index is formed. In the recovery scenario, this paper establishes a unified hierarchical scheduling model with three objectives. The first is to maximize the total loads recovery, the scheduling rationality and uniformity, then minimize the total recovery time. This paper applies the improved simulated annealing algorithm (SAA) to search this multi-objective optimal scheduling solution. Then, the modified IEEE 33-node system is used as a studied case to analyze the model and the result proves the rationality and effectiveness. It also shows that compared with other algorithms, the improved SAA could find a more competitive optimal allocation solution with an extremely low computing resource

articleTitle: Cluster control research of DC-type distributed generators based on multi-microgrids technology under DC distribution system
abstract: The construction of an efficient, low consumption, reliable DC distribution system is an important way to achieve flexible access and efficient matching of DC power and DC load. This paper describes the typical characteristics and topology of cluster control of multiple DC microgrids under DC power distribution. In order to realize system power decentralized management and self-discipline control, each DC microgrid is described by multi-segment P/U curve, and multi-microgrids system are used for power decentralized management based on their respective P/U curves. All the power management strategies are achieved by converter control. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed power management and control strategy.

articleTitle: Coordinated voltage and reactive power control scheme of HVAC meshed offshore grid of offshore wind power plant at Kriegers Flak
abstract: The Kriegers Flak Combined Grid Solution (KF CGS) is the first hybrid-asset project utilizing an offshore HVAC/HVDC interconnector through already established and under-commissioning large offshore wind power plants between East Denmark and Germany in the Baltic Sea. In total, the KF CGS utilizes above 520 km HVAC cables, and, in the Danish side, above 200 km 220 kV cables arranged into a meshed offshore transmission grid. As the cables approach critical lengths, the reactive power generation is dependant on the active power transfer. In the Danish side, the control is realized by an automatic voltage and reactive power control (AVR/RPC) of several switchable and variable reactors and transformers with tap-position controllers, and the Wind Power Plant Controllers (WPPC). In the German side, the voltage control is achieved by the HVDC Back-to-Back and WPPC and part of the Optimal Power Flow (OPF) by the Master Controller for Interconnector Operation (MIO). This paper introduces the overall control of the KF CGS and presents the proposed coordinated voltage and reactive power control and assets on the Danish side of the KF CGS interconnector.

articleTitle: A novel variable speed constant frequency generation system for steam turbine and boiler feed pump
abstract: The steam-driven mode of boiler feed pump usually controls speed by adjusting the opening of the intake valve of the steam turbine. This method will result in valve loss, especially in the condition of light load. In this paper, a new steam-driven BFP system with a motor which is driven by full-power converter is proposed. Steam turbine, pump and motor are coaxially connected. With the valve in a wide-open position, speed is controlled by adjusting the electromagnetic torque of the motor for generating, thus the valve loss can be reduced. Based on flow characteristics of valves and speed-torque characteristics of turbines and pumps, this paper proves that the proposed system can reduce losses, save energy and improve efficiency when compared with traditional driven mode. Then model of this power generation system is established. In view of requirements under specific working condition, control strategy for working mode switching between intake valve and converter is studied, which is capable of maintaining flexibility of this BFP generation system in different conditions. Finally, a practical case is studied to prove the feature of energy saving and feasibility and effectiveness of the system are validated by simulation.

articleTitle: Optimization of control parameters for PMSG-based wind farm and SVG considering subsynchronous interaction
abstract: Recently, sub-synchronous oscillations (SSO) phenomena have occurred in direct-drive permanent magnetic synchronous generator (D-PMSG) based wind farms. The majority of wind farms have installed the static var generator (SVG) to improve the voltage stability. But some oscillation events showed that SVG have produced adverse effect to the system. There are distinct subsynchronous interactions (SSI) between PMSG-based wind turbines and SVG. Researches have pointed out that when connected to a weak grid the improper control parameter is the main course of the SSI. Therefore, the control parameter of the system need be optimized considering the SSI problems. The mathematical model the analytical transfer function is derived firstly. Then the stable and feasible region of SVG's and PMSG's control parameter are determined according to stability criterion. At last, some coordination methods for the control parameters are proposed considering the SSI problems, and the electromagnetic simulations is carried out to verify the correctness and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on efficiency increase of the automatic voltage control system in Shanghai urban power grid
abstract: The automatic voltage control system (AVC) used to not well performed since its massive application in the urban power gird of Shanghai. As two main categories of voltage regulating units, electric power capacitor and on-load tap changer (OLTC) of power transformer are controlled by AVC system. The voltage regulating units are usually locked down and that leads to an unsatisfactory working efficiency. Under such circumstances, voltage quality of power grid may not be securely guaranteed facing various operation modes and power load during different time periods. With the goal of higher reliability and voltage qualified rate requirements, several measures had been taken to optimize voltage regulating strategy and solve units' defections. Besides, an efficiency index is proposed and defined to quantitatively evaluate the efficiency of AVC system. According to record data after strategy optimization and defection solving, the times that voltage regulating units lock down reduces significantly. So, it contributes to an obvious increase of AVC efficiency and all the measures are demonstrated effective by comparison. In addition, frequency and alerts times of substation busbar voltage threshold crossing reduces accordingly.

articleTitle: Modeling and forward suppressing strategy of circulating current in MMC-HVDC
abstract: The circulating current is a problem of modular multilevel converter. In the case of unreasonable selection of capacitance, output current fault and disturbance, the low frequency circulating current would appear, or even continuously amplify if the circulating current controller is set with inappropriate parameters. Through the modeling and equivalent analysis of the circulating current, this paper discussed the reasons leading to circulating current and the factors that influence frequency, deduced the relatioinship among arm current, output current and circulating current, come up with a forward control method to suppress circulating current based on the MMC equivalent model. As the signal of forward control, the circulating current without DC component is injected into the reference voltage to suppress the circulating current. Ultimately, the simulation results without circulating current, with PI control and with proposed forward suppressing strategy are illustrated in the paper respectively, which verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the forward control method. The discussed forward control algorithm could also effectively reduce the amount of calculation to improve the efficiency and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Synergetic control based on rotor speed regulation with variable proportional coefficient for doubly-fed wind turbines implementing virtual inertia support
abstract: Due to the rotor side converter of doubly-fed induction generator based on wind turbine (DFIG-WT) decouples its rotor kinetic energy to the grid frequency, the DFIG-WT has no ability to provide inertial support for the grid frequency disturbance. In this paper, the feasibility analysis for DFIG-WT providing frequency inertial support based on rotor speed control is discussed at first. Then, via analyzing the rotor speed control mechanism of DFIG-WT, a frequency support control based on variable proportional coefficient is proposed. At the same time, the synergetic control theory is adopted to design the control strategy of the variable proportion coefficient. Based on setting up the macro variable which is composed of grid frequency, the virtual inertia time constant and the increment of stator active power, the control law of the variable proportion coefficient can be derived through designing the dynamic characteristic of the macro variable to satisfy the first order inertia. The synergetic control will make the virtual inertia of DFIG vary with frequency, and it has better frequency regulation performance than traditional virtual inertia control. Finally, based on the simulation in WSCC 9-bus wind power system, the effectiveness of the proposed synergetic control strategy of virtual inertial is verified. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy has the advantage on adaptively regulating the variable proportion coefficient for implementing the DFIG-WTs with different operation state to coordinately provide the frequency support.

articleTitle: Investigating the transient torque of turbo-generators in a power system integrating wind farms
abstract: The renewable energy sources connected to the grid will cause the power system to oscillate and even affect neighbouring turbo-generators. For example, the wind turbines and their converter control systems may cause shaft torsional vibration in the steam turbine units, which affects the safety of the system. Therefore, it is of significance to investigate the transient torque of turbo-generators in a power system integrating wind farms. This paper takes a power plant in Inner Mongolia area of China as the case, the power of which is transmitted via the AC/DC hybrid power system with wind and thermal power. A typical equivalent system model of the wind-thermal-bundled access network is established firstly. Consider setting the fault on the line with series capacitor compensation and observe units' torque variation. Then the impact on sub-synchronous resonance (SSR) characteristics from many factors was investigated through the time-domain simulation, including the unit combination mode (including the long-term accessed DFIGs condition), the fault type and position, the system equivalent impedance, the fault starting/clearing time and the mechanical mutual damping coefficient of shafting, etc. Finally, the influence of each factor on transient torque is summarized, and the inner associations between the shaft torsional vibration in the turbo-generators and the converter-based wind turbines are clarified.

articleTitle: Forced clearing and its pricing in renewable energy markets
abstract: To promote the renewable energy technologies, the concept of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) and Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) are developed. Increasing the purchase of Renewable Energy Certificate (RECs) will encourages the production of renewable energy on a broader scale. Naturally, a market model is proposed based on the background of the RECs market. In order to overcome the flaws of the model, a new two-stage clearing model with classical market clearing and forced clearing is established where the market participants are properly distinguished according to their contributions to the comprehensive social welfare. Then the possible pricing methods for the two-stage clearing model, especially for the forced clearing, are analysed based on the developed pricing principles. Subsequently, a concentration ratio-based pricing method is proposed for the forced clearing and validated based on the established pricing principles. Finally, the proposed model and pricing method are verified by numerical cases.

articleTitle: Research on the joint planning and benefit allocation of distribution networks under the environment of incremental distribution business liberalization
abstract: The release of distribution network investment is the exploration of China's reform in the natural monopoly of transmission and distribution. Compared with the traditional monopoly distribution network, the distribution network invested in the way of mixed ownership has no support from other networks' backup resources, so the cost of reliability planning is high. However, the distribution networks can reduce investment cost through coordinated planning. Firstly, the influence of the coordination of distributed power generation and tie lines on reliability planning is analysed, and the reliability investment cost model of distribution network is established. Then the cooperative game model of distribution network is proposed. Finally, based on the Shapley value, the benefit allocation strategy of multiple distribution network joint planning is proposed. Three distribution networks are used to simulate all possible joint planning modes. It is found that the distribution network planning can expand the power supply range of distributed generations and improve the utilization rate of power distribution equipment by coordinating distributed generations and tie lines. Based on the Shapley value allocation strategy, the benefits of the cooperative alliance can be reasonably allocated.

articleTitle: Stability-constrained offshore transmission planning for large-scale remote wind farm
abstract: VSC-HVDC system is a recent technology, which has demonstrated its effective power system controllability. It cannot only facilitate long-distance bulk power transmission but also provide auxiliary services, including voltage regulation services to connected AC system. How to efficiently utilize its advantages and properly integrate multi-terminal HVDC into an existing AC system is a worthwhile issue. This paper deals with the issue of utilizing MTDC system to integrate multiple offshore wind farms into AC systems. A comprehensive decision support model is proposed which covers three key factors that characterize offshore wind farm integration: investment cost, system stability and the interactions between MTDC and local AC system. The main decisions concern integrated AC bus location and appropriate converter size installed at the corresponding MTDC terminals. To better fit into the real-world operation, various wind speed and load scenarios have been considered. The proposed model has been tested to integrate two wind farms to a benchmark AC system via a MTDC grid. The case study will be used to demonstrate how the proposed model can be used as a decision-making tool for grid connection of multiple wind farms via MTDC transmission technology.

articleTitle: Research on distribution network PMU configuration scheme based on parameter estimation accuracy
abstract: For the parameter identification requirements of active distribution network, PMU configuration needs to take into account many factors such as observability and economy. It requires to achieve optimal configuration to meet the identification accuracy requirements. Based on the multi-period measurements of SCADA and PMU deployed at both ends of distribution network line, this paper presents a PMU configuration method aiming at improving the accuracy of the overall line parameters of distribution network system. Considering the distribution network topology, PMU configuration and different noise sensitivity of branches, this paper adopts the concept of dominant parameters and nondominant parameters. And then gives the dominant parameter evaluation method, starting with the application objectives of parameter estimation and the influence of branch parameters on state estimation. Based on this model, the improved genetic algorithm is used to optimize the quantity and location of PMU configuration. The quantity of PMU configuration and dominant index are considered as fitness functions. IEEE33 buses active distribution network model is built in simulated program to obtain simulation data considering load fluctuation and measurement error. By contrast with the normal configuration, the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling based Bayesian multivariate linear spline load forecasting agent for smart microgrid energy management system
abstract: This paper proposes a load forecasting agent for a multi-agent based energy management system (EMS) in a smart microgrid. EMS in a microgrid is responsible for providing dispatch strategies for the generation units requiring both the renewable resource forecast and load forecast. The efficiency of the EMS significantly relies on the accuracy of the forecasting. Classical piecewise linear models use single optimized parameters according to cross-validation score or penalized likelihood. They fail to accommodate the uncertainty of parameter values, which results in the regression surface become non-smooth. The proposed model considers a Bayesian analysis of the piecewise linear model, which has been assembled by the basis function approach. The basis function approach generalizes the univariate linear splines to higher dimensions, which naturally enforces the mean level continuity at the boundaries of regions. The posterior distribution of the response variable is achieved by integrating the posterior model space by altering numbers and locations of planes. As a result, a Bayesian local linear model with predictive distribution and a group of local linear parameters are achieved, which quantifies the forecast uncertainty imposed in the model. The proposed model shows better forecasting accuracy of 97.0559%, and therefore implemented as an agent for microgrid EMS.
