To cope with the fluctuation uncertainties of wind power in different scenarios, the proposed control strategy optimizes the state of charge (SOC) of HESS, yielding sufficient margin to keep the HESS control effects sustainable. Appropriate penalty items are added to the objective function to prevent the optimization problem from being unresolvable due to the energy and power limitation of HESS. The effectiveness of the control strategy is verified through a case study based on realistic wind farm data.

articleTitle: Investment decision model of smart city multi-energy system based on supply and demand characteristics analysis
abstract: With the opening of the competition in the electricity sales market, smart cities, as the best experimental carrier for the comprehensive utilization of multi-energy, have a unique position in the field of comprehensive energy. Therefore, this paper constructs a profit model of comprehensive energy services. Firstly, by analyzing the energy supply system of the smart city multi-energy system, the typical application scenarios of the smart city multi-energy system are proposed. Secondly, the energy consumption characteristics of typical smart city users, including industrial enterprises, public institutions and residents are analyzed to study the transformation trend of smart city's multi-energy interconnection operation mode promoted by new electricity reform. Finally, the cost model of comprehensive energy service and the investment model for comprehensive energy service companies is proposed.

articleTitle: Single-phase-to-ground fault diagnosis method based on waveform features and association rule algorithm
abstract: The single-phase-to-ground fault current of distribution network is small, which brings difficulties to fault diagnosis. A single-phase-to-ground fault diagnosis method based on synchronous waveform feature extraction and association rule mining is proposed. Firstly, features are extracted from waveform of fault recorders to describe the fault scene. Then, FP-Growth algorithm is used to mine the association rules in the fault transaction database. The effectiveness of proposed method is verified by IEEE 34-bus system. Algorithm in this paper provides a useful reference for fault diagnosis technology based on fault waveform features.

articleTitle: The small signal stability analysis of DC distribution network
abstract: As a new type of power supply, the characteristic of DC distribution network are quite different from that of the AC distribution network. Distributed generations are mostly combined to the grid through converters, which results in less inertia and more stability problems. Therefore, the stability of DC distribution network is studied in this paper. Based on the state-space averaging method and Lyapunov stability theory, the state space model of each element of DC distribution network is established and linearized. The linearized state space model of DC distribution network is established to analyse the stability of DC distribution network. The analysis results show that the high proportion constant power loads is not conducive to the stable operation of the system, and the upper limit of the proportion of constant power loads should be set. In order to improve the system stability, the influence of equivalent ground capacitance of DC distribution network on the system stability is studied in this paper. The analysis results show that increasing equivalent ground capacitance can improve the system stability, and the minimum equivalent capacitance to make the system stable is given which provides an important reference for the reasonable configuration of DC distribution network.

articleTitle: A stability criterion for DC distribution power system with multi-voltage levels
abstract: DC distribution power system (DPS) develops rapidly and its topology is more complicated than before emerging the feature of multi-voltage levels, many DC buses and numerous converters. As a result, the stability issue of DC bus voltage becomes significantly prominent and conventional stability criteria may not have the ability to judge stability very succinctly. This paper will address the stability issue of DC DPS with multi-voltage levels. Based on classification of any converter as either a bus voltage controlled converter (BVCC) or a bus current controlled converter (BCCC), the unified form, two-port small signal model and equivalent loop gain of the system are derived. Here, the DC transformer could adopt output current or output voltage control modes, which has impact on above derivation results. After that, the system stability can be judged by whether the equivalent loop gain satisfies Nyquist criterion or not. Finally, an experimental prototype is established to validate the effectiveness of the proposed criterion.

articleTitle: A review of research on subsynchronous resonance of wind power generation
abstract: In the case of multiple grid-connected wind farm accidents in China and the United States, the increasing sub-synchronous resonance (SSR) problem has attracted great attention. For the double-fed induction generator (DFIG), the SSR is caused by a series-compensation. For the permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG), the SSR is caused by the interaction of power electronic converters with the grid. Because the SSR problem affects the stability of the power system, it is necessary to analyze the mechanism of the SSR phenomenon in wind farms, so as to put forward the corresponding suppression methods. This paper mainly includes modeling of the DFIG and the PMSG based wind farm, SSR mechanism analysis, the suppression methods of the SSR. In the end, the problems in the research of wind power SSR are summarized.

Author Keywords: DOUBLE INDUCTION GENERATIONPERMANENT MAGNET SYNCHRONOUS GENERATION

articleTitle: Research on power dispatch balance problem of high renewable energy penetration ratio system
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy such as wind power and PV in China, the uncertainty of output has a great impact on the power balance and the work of ensuring power supply is very arduous. In this paper, the fluctuation characteristics and seasonal characteristics of China's renewable energy output is introduced and the monthly electricity balance and day-ahead power balance problem is analyzed. On this basis, simulation analyses of high proportion new energy system in 2025 is presented basing on new energy production simulation method. Simulation results give some advice to how to ensure the power balance in the future when the proportion of new energy is increasing.

articleTitle: Improved stochastic power flow algorithm based on discrete-normal stacking of cumulants
abstract: In recent years, with the social economy advancing and the energy demand growing, distributed generation (DG) and electric vehicle (EV)booming have brought many challenges to power flow calculation and voltage analysis in distribution network. Stochastic power flow algorithm is an important tool to evaluate the voltage amplitude randomness of DGs and EVs. This paper presents an improved discrete-normal cumulants stacking algorithm to calculate voltage amplitude curve in the case of DGs integration with high penetration rate. It not only avoids the distortion of the results using the Gram-Charlier series expansion with the high randomness, but also solves the numerous repeated calculations of Monte Carlo algorithm, giving attention to the calculation accuracy and efficiency. The correctness of this method suggested in this paper is verified through the voltage amplitude simulation results of IEEE34-node system.

articleTitle: Development and application of SF6 insulated GIS true defect simulation device
abstract: GIS equipment has the advantages of compact structure and high reliability, but in recent years, the operation data show that GIS equipment causes insulation accident due to the insulation defects during the manufacture and operation, it is urgent to quantitatively analyze the operating parameters and state characteristics of GIS equipment under the condition of insulation defects. Therefore, the GIS real defect simulator has been designed and developed. The device consists of four parts: the sulfur fluoride gas chamber, solid insulation parts, the defect simulation device, observation and measurement device four parts. The defect device can effectively simulate four typical insulation defects of free metal particles, bubble defects in the solid insulation, needle/plate and plate/plate electrode discharge, and apply two types of DC/AC voltage. Three-dimensional finite element simulation model of GIS true type defect simulation device is first set up in this paper. The electric field distribution of four typical insulation defects, the central guide rods and the basin insulators in the simulation device is analyzed, and reasons for decomposition of the SF6 gas body under the defect condition are analyzed theoretically. On this basis, the variation trend of SF6's trace gas with time, the characteristics of fully mechanized partial discharge and the trend of gas change under the condition of failure are analyzed. The defect type clustering algorithm is proposed and applied to pattern recognition of fault types of actual gas combiner. The research results have the theoretical guiding value for the fault diagnosis and pattern recognition of GIS equipment.

articleTitle: Assessment of voltage fluctuations based on wind power fluctuation characteristics
abstract: In China, the progressive grid integration of large-scale wind power into structural weak points is accompanied by grid voltage fluctuations and other challenges like chain tripping. This work first focuses on the mechanism of voltage fluctuations caused by large-scale wind power integration, and the mathematical relationship between voltage fluctuations and wind power fluctuations is established. Then, the fluctuation characteristics of wind power in multi-time scales are analysed by wavelet methods, a power law model representing wind power fluctuations is established. Finally, a method for assessing voltage fluctuations rooted in wind power fluctuations in different time-scales is presented. This method takes the stochastic wind power fluctuations into full account so as to give a quantitative risk assessment of voltage fluctuations to grid operators. Furthermore, the influence of wind power integrating point on voltage fluctuations is studied based on the simulation results. The simulation results show that this method can be widely used in different types of wind power system analysis scenarios.

articleTitle: Medium and long-term power market risk assessment and comprehensive evaluation
abstract: With the advancement of the reform of China's power market, the power market brings expected benefits to market participants, but at the same time it also faces huge financial risks. Therefore, risk management and safety control of the power market become more and more important. This paper sorts out various risks that may occur in the medium and long-term power market, makes quantitative analysis on various risks, and establishes a set of medium and long-term power market risk evaluation index system from the perspective of power market operation. In addition, this paper combines the principal component analysis and Delphi method to establish a comprehensive evaluation model of medium and long-term power market operation risk based on support vector regression. Finally, an example analysis is carried out to prove the effectiveness of the model, which can accurately evaluate the medium and long-term power market operation risks and provide useful reference for market designers.

articleTitle: Forecast of power quality disturbance events in urban distribution networks incorporating weather conditions
abstract: In order to forecast power quality (PQ) disturbance events and extract the PQ disturbance modes, this paper proposed a hidden markov model (HMM) based forecasting method. In the first stage, symbolic aggregate approximation (SAX) is used to clean and discretize the PQ data and weather data. The second stage calculates the entropy correlation coefficient (ECC) for measuring the correlation between weather conditions and PQ disturbance states and selecting weather sensitive region. The third stage formulates the power disturbance dynamics utilizing HMM. The results of the forecast of power disturbance events are obtained in the fourth stage, in which the Bayes formula is used to calculate the probability of PQ disturbance events occurrence. The urban power grid field data were taken as an example to verify the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method. Compared with traditional methods, the HMM based method incorporating weather conditions has higher forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Machine side DC-port impedance modeling and characteristic analysis of PMSG wind turbines
abstract: Due to the large single-unit capacity, high power generation efficiency, good control performance and high reliability, permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSG) account for a higher proportion in offshore wind farms. The power collection system for offshore PMSG wind farms consist of AC and DC strategies. In the DC collection system, the DC-port impedance model of PMSG machine-side model has not been carried out. This paper builds the sequence impedance model of PMSG machine-side model on the DC-port, and verifies the proposed model by the point-by-point simulation measurement. The proposed modular modeling of the machine-side model facilitates the construction of different offshore wind farm DC collection and delivery systems impedance model.

articleTitle: Regional adaptability and economic evaluation based on electric vehicle policy analysis
abstract: Promoting the use of electric vehicles can alleviate the economic pressure brought by petroleum for many countries. It can also reduce the pollutant emissions when using vehicles through the uptake of relatively clean energy, which can promote the replacement of traditional fossil fuels by green energy, and improve the life quality. In order to better promote the use of electric vehicles, and gradually move toward various industry sectors, such as civilian cars, family cars, and small cars, it is imperative to study their regional adaptability and economy. Therefore, this paper firstly introduces the relevant policies for promoting the application of electric vehicles in the community, including the electricity tariff policies, etc. Then, taking into account the existing load level of the community, the capacity of distribution lines, the number of charging piles, the charging power, the factors affecting the promotion of electric vehicles and their adaptability are analyzed. Furthermore, the economic evaluation index system of electric vehicles is established, and the feasibility is verified by an example. Finally, the case studies are presented to validate the proposed regional adaptability and economic evaluation methods.

articleTitle: Virtual inertia online control strategy for DC grid based on variable droop coefficient
abstract: The access of renewable energy leads to greater randomness of DC power flow. Unified droop control strategy can ensure better stability of the system, but it has poor dynamic regulation ability for stochastic fluctuating power and has steady-state error. Based on the analysis of the relationship between the output impedance of the converter and the system inertia of the DC grid and the influence of the system inertia on the control characteristics of the DC grid, this paper proposes a control strategy to change the virtual system inertia by changing droop coefficient. Changing the virtual inertia of the system by adjusting the output impedance of the converter through exchanging the state information of online converters by low-speed communication, improves the dynamic and steady-state control characteristics of the system. Finally, a four-terminal MVDC power grid simulation system with PV and storage devices is established in MATLAB. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy has better dynamic performance and improves the quality of MV-DC voltage.

articleTitle: Integrated energy system planning with distributed generation based on emergy theory
abstract: There are complex coupling characteristics between energy sources in integrated energy systems. Reasonable planning of coupling equipment effectively improves the renewable energy accommodation in integrated energy systems. Now less quantified the social resources of human resources included in the total energy supply. Based on the theory of emergy, we quantify the heterogeneous resources better. At the same time, we quantitatively analyse the energy system production efficiency more reasonably. Then we propose a bi-level programming model of the coupling equipment for the integrated energy system. The objective of upper level is the minimization of annual cost of the integrated energy system for coupling equipment locating and sizing. The objective of the lower level is the maximum of emergy yield ratio, in order to provide the best operational data for the upper level. Finally, verified by comparing the example with the traditional planning scheme, we improve the effectiveness of the proposed planning method in reducing improving emergy yield ratio.

articleTitle: Research on background harmonic evaluation of UHV DC access considering mutual impedance of external nodes of power grid
abstract: At present, the background harmonic evaluation of the UHV DC integration into receiving power grid needs to consider the equivalence of the external power grid. The existing methods are independent equivalence of single point of the external power grid. When there are many external nodes, multiple single-point equivalence are needed. Node superposition will cause the model to have a large deviation from the actual, and ultimately affect the accuracy of the method. This paper proposes an external grid equivalent strategy that takes into account the mutual impedance of multiple external nodes. The external grid equivalent is the self-impedance of a single node and the mutual impedance of any two nodes. The self-impedance can be equivalent to the short-circuit capacity of a single node. The mutual impedance is equivalent to the connection relationship between the two nodes. A UHV DC integration was carried out to carry out background harmonic evaluation, and the actual measurement of the 220kV side and 500kV outlet of the six 500kV substations was carried out. Based on the measured data, ETAP software was used to establish six 500kV substations and 9 external grid nodes. The background harmonic evaluation model verifies the agreement between the model and the measured data. The model is used to evaluate the background harmonic level of the UHV DC project, which provides a technical basis for the filter design.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis of transient interaction between wind farms
abstract: Model simulation is the mainstream method for low voltage ride through (LVRT) capability assessment of wind farms. To make sure the wind farm model simulated as the real­life system, the detailed model of target wind farm is needed. Meanwhile, in high density wind farm group, the transient performance of a wind farm could be influenced by neighbouring wind farms. The accuracy of LVRT simulation results is also related to the external wind farms if there are large interaction. It is necessary to investigate the interaction between wind farms in a wind farm group to find out whether the neighbouring wind farms should be considered and modelled as an aggregation model. The quantitative analysis method of interaction between wind farms during grid fault is proposed in this paper. The typical T-connection and radial connection topologies of wind farm groups are introduced. With the simplified mathematical model of wind farm group, key factors of transient interaction are derived. Additionally, the quantitative method of interaction is studied, and the influence coefficient is calculated through performance comparison between wind farms with and without interaction considered. The calculation results of a typical wind farm group demonstrate the effectiveness of the method proposed.

articleTitle: A fault-tolerant control strategy for six-phase PMLG in direct-drive wave energy conversion system
abstract: Permanent magnet linear generator (PMLG) is widely used in the direct-drive wave energy converter (DDWEC). Since the wave energy conversion (WEC) system is located below the sea level, the maintenance is not convenient, it is necessary to study the methods to improve the reliability of DDWEC. Compared with traditional three-phase PMLG, six-phase PMLG has good fault-tolerant ability and more control freedom and the fluctuation of electromagnetic thrust can be reduced. In this paper, a fault-tolerant control strategy for six-phase PMLG in DDWEC based on synthetic vector method is proposed. By changing the amplitude and phase angle of the phase currents, the six-phase generator can continue operating and the reduction of electromagnetic thrust is lesser. The finite-element simulation model is established and the validity of the fault-tolerant control strategy is verified by simulation results. Because it is difficult to maintain the generator in the seawater environment, the fault-tolerant control strategy is of great significance to six-phase PMLG in the direct-drive wave energy conversion system.

articleTitle: Study on reliability improvement of current-transferring type HVDC circuit breaker
abstract: The current-transferring type HVDC circuit breaker (CT-DCB) can reduce the investment cost and optimize the equipment utilization value. However, the operation reliability of the CT-DCB is lower than the hybrid HVDC breaker (H-DCB). In order to improve its reliability, the reliability improvement methods based on the equipment level and the system level are proposed. In the equipment level, a new diode clamped CT-DCB is proposed to improve the device reliability. In the system level, a redundant configuration strategy is proposed to improve the dc fault isolation capability and the backup protection capability. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme, a simulation model of four-terminal HVDC transmission system with the diode clamped CT-DCB is established in PSCAD/EMTDC. Simulation results prove validity and feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling method for wind power accommodation based on wind-nuclear coordination
abstract: Targeting at the problem of wind power accommodation in coastal areas with large-scale wind power and nuclear power, the optimal scheduling method of wind-nuclear coordination is studied. The wind power output and the load following of nuclear power are analysed for the complementary characteristics. Based on the economic optimization of power system, an optimal scheduling method of wind-nuclear power is proposed, where the constraints of time coupling and load following depth are considered to meet the safety requirement of nuclear power operation. Simulation results of a numerical example verify the validity and effectiveness of the method. Results show that the wind power output is complementary with the load following of nuclear power; the optimal scheduling method of wind-nuclear coordination can comprehensively balance the operation cost and environment benefits, which realises the improvement of both the overall economy and the wind power accommodation.

articleTitle: Model predictive power control of brushless doubly fed twin stator induction generator for grid synchronization and power generation
abstract: This paper presents a model predictive power control (MPPC) algorithm for the brushless doubly fed twin stator induction generator (BDFTSIG) in wind power generation applications. The MPPC controller has unified control structure during grid synchronization mode and power generation mode. The control objective for grid synchronization mode is minimizing the error of virtual power to realize fast and smooth grid synchronization. The control objective for power generation mode considers optimal power control and further incorporates the penalty of switching frequency and linear multistep prediction, which can reduce the switching frequency while assure stable operation, and is of great significance in large capacity wind power generation systems. A 2MW platform of the BDFTSIG system is established based on the method of multi-rate discrete simulation, which validates the effectiveness of the proposed MPPC controller during both the grid synchronization mode and power generation mode.

Author Keywords: brushless doubly fed twin stator induction generator

articleTitle: Model of long-term yield evaluation for PV station
abstract: In this paper, a model of long-term yield evaluation for PV station is established. The efficiency of key components for PV station is analyzed. Meanwhile, the factors which affecting the efficiency of PV station yield are also analyzed. Based on these, the model of PV station yield is established. Based on this model, the long-term yield of PV station can be evaluated.

articleTitle: Application and design of VSC-HVDC distribution networks for connection of renewable energy sources
abstract: Voltage Source Converter (VSC) based HVDC distribution networks have a number of technical advantages compared with traditional AC distribution networks, especially for easy connection of distributed renewable energy sources. This paper presents the application and design of VSC-HVDC distribution networks for connection of renewable energy sources. The selection of the topology of the networks, configuration of the converter station and the key equipment of VSC-HVDC distribution networks are discussed. Finally the design parameters of a pilot project of a three terminal VSC-HVDC distribution network for connection of renewable energy sources is presented.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on network security vulnerabilities of renewable energy field stations
abstract: As the main power generation method of renewable energy, the extensive construction of wind power and photovoltaic power stations has brought about new energy-saving and emission reduction, and also added new vulnerabilities to the network security of power grid enterprises. Most of the regenerative energy stations are built in open and sparsely populated areas, and it is impossible to guarantee the 24-hour inspection of equipment, which is easily destroyed by personnel intentionally or unintentionally. Based on the investigation of wind power, photovoltaic power station control and network access and grid interconnection methods, this paper analyses the network security vulnerability of renewable energy stations and proposes solutions to provide new suggestions for grid security.

articleTitle: A decision-making method for berthed electric-ships based on generalized nash game
abstract: Conventional seaports only need to provide cargo loading/unloading services to the berthed-in ships. Nowadays, due to the extensive electrification of the seaport and the growing concerns on the maritime environmental issues, the berthed-in ships are required to switch into the cold-ironing (on-shore power supply) mode to prevent the Greenhouse gas (GHG) emission. In general, each berthed-in ship may have different service requirement, i.e., cold-ironing power, cargo mass, berthed-out time and service flexibility. However, due to limited working conditions of a seaport, i.e., transmission limits, number of berth positions, cargo loading/unloading rates and so on, those service demands may not be compatible to each other. In this paper, a transactive market model is proposed to manage the real-time service demands of the berthed ships, i.e., cold-ironing power, loading/unloading cargo, expected berthed-out time. The real-time decision of each ship is determined by the clearing of the proposed transactive market according to the above real-time service requests and the service flexibility response of the ship owners. The transactive market is modelled as a Generalized Nash Game (GNG), and the case study demonstrates the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Efficiency and benefit evaluation of multi-energy microgrid considering multi-type heat pump
abstract: With the advancement of China's comprehensive energy services, the multi-energy microgrid has become more and more popular. As a typical substitution of electric energy, the heat pump has remarkable social and economic benefits in the multi-energy microgrid. In order to better develop comprehensive energy services, it is of vital importance to evaluate the efficiency and benefit of the microgrid. In this paper, the differences of several types of heat pumps are considered, and a day-ahead economic dispatch model for electric-thermal-gas microgrid is established. From the technical and economic perspectives, some indicators to measure the efficiency and benefit of multi-energy microgrid are then proposed. Case studies of a typical park-level multi-energy microgrid shows that these indicators can reflect the effect of heat pump on the efficiency and benefit of multi-energy microgrid. In addition, case studies also draw a conclusion that the heat pump can improve the rate of energy utilization and the economics of microgrid operation, and different types of heat pumps have different effects in improving the efficiency and benefit of multi-energy microgrid.

articleTitle: An improved fault recovery strategy for active distribution network considering LVRT capability of DG
abstract: The growing integration of distributed generation (DG) has changed the operation characteristics of traditional distribution network, and so the active distribution network (ADN) has emerged. Fault recovery is significant to reduce the loss of power failure, but the traditional control strategy without consideration of DG is no longer suitable for ADN. An improved fault recovery strategy is proposed to coordinate the fault reclosing and the low voltage ride through (LVRT) capability of DG. The influence of fault reclosing on the voltage variation of the point of common coupling (PCC) of DG is analyzed, with different relative locations of fault and PCC, and a critical LVRT voltage is extracted from the scenario where fault reclosing fails. In order to avoid DG outage, a blocking criterion of fault reclosing is presented according to the fault location and the first voltage dip of PCC. Then, the ADN can be split into planned islands considering the balance of DG power and loads and the load priorities, once the fault reclosing is blocked. Moreover, the WAMS Light is implemented for high-speed synchronous data collection and online central control. A case study is conducted to verify the effectiveness of proposed approach.

articleTitle: Greedy strategy and self-adaptive crossover operator based monarch butterfly optimization for simultaneous integration of renewables and battery energy storage in distribution systems
abstract: The article presents, a bi-level optimization framework for optimally deploying and managing solar and wind power base DG (Distribution Generator). An energy storage system (BESS) is also implemented in a power distribution network (PDN) to maximize the renewable hosting capacity of distribution networks. A new objective function is broached with the consideration of annual energy losses, reverse power flow into the grid, node voltage deviation, non-utilised BESS capacities and round-trip conversion losses of BESS. As a high installation and maintenance cost is associated with BESS it's observed to install one BESS in the system which is to be placed at the nodes of DG. Artificial intelligence based optimal control and management system is projected to adequately manage the high renewable power generation. Greedy strategy and self-adaptive crossover operator base monarch butterfly optimization (GCMBO) had been applied as an optimization tool. in order to ensure the efficacy of the presented model, it is tested and implemented on a 3 3-bus benchmark test distribution system under various test cases. Various simulation studies have been carried out which depicts the usefulness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: MIMO impedance based stability analysis of DFIG-based wind farm with MMC-HVDC in modifed sequence domain
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) based high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission is widely applied for the large-scale wind farm integration making its interaction stability analysis especially significant. However, only a few related researches have so far been done and most of them depict ac-side characteristics of the connected MMC station using simplified single-input-single-output (SISO) impedance, which is not able to reflect all harmonic couplings and sequence couplings. To solve this issue, based on the harmonic state-space method, the multi-input-multi-output (MIMO) impedance model of the MMC in modified sequence domain are established to better characterize the MMC's off-diagonal coupling effects. Also, the accurate MIMO impedance model of the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farm is used in this paper. Subsequently, the generalized Nyquist criterion is applied to analyse the stability of such MIMO interconnected system. The accuracy of the established MMC's MIMO impedance model is verified via the frequency scanning, and the theoretical stability analysis of the interconnected system is validated by time-domain simulations in Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Virtual synchronous generator controlled matrix converter for grid integration in distributed generation and microgrid
abstract: Matrix converter (MC) is a direct AC/AC converter and it is an effective alternative solution to the conventional AC/DC/AC converter. Due to its advantages, MC has been widely researched and applied in many application fields, however its application in microgrid remains underexplored. This paper investigates the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control for the three-phase MC applied in distributed generation and microgrid. MC is controlled by the VSG control strategy to imitate the performance of the synchronous generator. The VSG controlled MC is based on the mathematical model of synchronous generator and behaves in a similar manner to a synchronous generator. In this way, the benefits of synchronous generator can be integrated into MC and significant inertia and damping are provided. The frequency, voltage, real power and reactive power can be controlled effectively. Therefore, the regulation performance of MC is enhanced, making it suitable for microgrid applications. This facilitates the regulation of system frequency and voltage. The hysteresis band (HB) current controller is adopted in this paper to control the MC so that the required current can be produced. Simulation tests are carried out in MATLAB/Simulink and the obtained results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Optimal decision making model of battery energy storage-assisted electric vehicle charging station considering incentive demand response
abstract: Considering large scale implementation of electric vehicles (EVs), public EV charging stations are served as fuel tanks for EVs to meet the need of longer travelling distance and overcome the shortage of private charging piles. The allocation of local battery energy storage (BES) can enhance the flexibility of the EV charging station. This paper proposes an optimal decision making model of the BES-assisted EV charging station considering the incentive demand response. Firstly, the detailed models of the BES-assisted EV charging station are presented. Secondly, as a representative incentive demand response, the emergency demand response (EDR) model is introduced. Thirdly, based on the charging load forecast data, an optimal decision making model of the BES-assisted EV charging station considering the EDR to maximize the charging station's operating profit is established. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified through case studies. The conclusions of this paper are as follows: 1) Through the optimal decision making model, correct and profitable EDR participation decision can be determined for the BES-assisted EV charging station effectively. 2) Local BES in the EV charging station can improve the charging station's ability to participate in the EDR.

articleTitle: High impedance fault detection in distribution network using convolutional neural network based on distribution-level PMU data
abstract: High impedance faults (HIFs) have become a serious challenge of distribution networks which are difficult to be detected by the traditional protection scheme. And the access of distributed generations (DGs) makes the fault description more difficult. With the development of distribution-level phasor measurement units (D-PMUs), visual and precise synchronous data could be used for distribution network. In this paper, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based HIF detection method is proposed. The extracted synchronous transient HIF characteristics of decomposed the zero sequence current by wavelet transform is used as the input feature of CNN model. Considering the particularity of fault detection, some of targeted improvement is adopted, which includes local response normalization (LRN) and L2 regularization among multiple optimizations. The proposed HIF detection method is robust to the noise, disturbance, and time window. The performance had been tested on a 20-node distribution network with DGs in PSCAD, where the accuracy rate can reach 97% and the anti-interference capacity and effectiveness was justified from multi aspects.

articleTitle: A new suppression strategy for switching frequency circulating current in parallel inverters
abstract: In parallel inverter system, switching frequency circulating current will occur between inverters due to phase difference of carrier signals, resulting in distortion of the output current waveform, increasing system loss, and seriously jeopardizing the safety of the system. In order to solve this problem effectively, the mechanism of switching frequency circulating current is analyzed, a mathematical model which can analyze the influencing factors of switching frequency circulating current in parallel inverters is established, and the main influencing factors are revealed. Furthermore, a low-cost and practical switching frequency circulating current suppression strategy is proposed without increasing the system volume and loss. In this strategy, virtual inductance control is added to the double closed loop PI control of voltage outer loop and current inner loop. It can regulate the reference voltage by controlling the virtual inductance voltage drop to achieve the purpose of simulating the actual inductance, so as to suppress the circulating current. The simulation model of parallel inverter system based on Simulink and the RT-LAB semi-physical simulation experimental platform is built. Simulation and experiment results show that the suppression strategy can effectively suppress switching frequency circulating current, which verifies the effectiveness and practicability of the suppression strategy.

articleTitle: Monitoring bond wire fatigue based on modeling of IGBT module on-state voltage drop
abstract: With the growing penetration of renewable generation, more IGBT modules are applied in photovoltaic (PV) systems. The aging failure of IGBT modules exists in its entire life cycle, and it is with no doubt the key factor that influence the reliability of the whole converter system. The bond wire fatigue is the main reason leads to the increase of loss power and heat generation of the module, which will further shorten the remaining useful lifetime of the converter and sabotage the system reliability. The equivalent circuit is used to analyse the IGBT conduction characteristics, which reveals the influence brought by the breaking and shedding of bond wires on the IGBT on-state saturation voltage drop. However, bond wire fatigue is not the only reason that affects the chip on-state saturation voltage drop. Therefore, a forward characteristic modeling of IGBT based on instantaneous on-state resistance is proposed, in order to provide a complete understanding of the on-state saturation voltage drop considering the effects from both the collector current and junction temperature. The model can be used to judge whether the on-saturation voltage drop deviates from its theoretical value under corresponding working conditions, which can tell if the bond wire fatigue occurs or not.

articleTitle: The visualization technology of the UHVDC control and protection system based on deep learning
abstract: Massive signals are exchanged in the UHVDC control and protection system, which cannot be conveniently obtained and understood, and thus cause huge workload of information retrieval and low maintenance efficiency of the UHVDC control and protection system. To address the above issue, the visualization technology of the UHVDC control and protection system based on deep learning is proposed. Firstly, based on the fast convolution neural network technology and Tesseract-OCR engine for optical character recognition, the information recorded on the diagrams of the control and protection devices can be identified, modelled and stored. Then with the query of the database, the board connections of control and protection devices can also be identified. Moreover, the association relationship between the board connection and exchanged signals can be established. Hence, the visualizations of the exchanged signal and board connection of the UHVDC control and protection system can be realized, which can be greatly helpful for the information retrieval and improve the maintenance efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the peak load shifting technology of flexible interconnected distribution network based on SNOP
abstract: Soft Normally Open Point (SNOP) can flexibly interconnect multiple 10kV feeders through DC-Link, thus realizing closed-loop operation between different feeders. If SNOP is equipped with energy storage device, it can not only reduce the maximum power of feeder by power support between feeders, but also optimize the peak load shifting of multi-feed lines by energy storage device, which can further improve the utilization efficiency of 10kV equipment, and improve the operation of power distribution network. In this paper, a new peak-cutting and valley-filling technology is proposed for SNOP connected to multiple 10kV feeders. Firstly, an optimization model of peak-shaving and valley-filling based on minimum variance of daily load is established. Secondly, an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to solve the peak-shaving and valley-filling optimization model of flexible interconnected distribution network, and the flow chart of the algorithm is given. Finally, taking the DC distribution center with three feedbacks in Guizhou power grid as an example, the optimization technology of peak-shaving and valley-filling proposed in this paper is simulated, and the rationality and effectiveness of the optimization strategy are verified.

articleTitle: An LSTM-attention wind power prediction method considering multiple factors
abstract: To date, though the wind energy penetration level increases gradually in the micro-grid system, its randomness and intermittency have negative impacts on the system stability and power dispatch capability. Therefore, the accurate short-term prediction for the wind energy generation is indispensable to help smoothing the power fluctuation and improving the power quality. Wind power generation presents continuity and regularity, traditional prediction methods cannot grab all the historical data. In this paper, a wind power prediction method based on the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)-Attention algorithm is proposed. Since wind power presents a strong temporal regularity, Attention mechanism is used to distribute different weights to historical inputs to better mine temporal characteristics. What is more, traditional prediction methods only use historical power data to make a curve prediction. But the generation of wind power is influenced by local environmental. In this paper, the prediction model takes several related environmental factors into account, including local temperature, local air pressure, local humidity, and the wind speed. According to the experimental results, good prediction results can be achieved by this LSTM-Attention wind power prediction method considering multiple factors.

articleTitle: Cooperative scheduling strategy of distributed energy storage system in regional grid with high proportion of renewable energy
abstract: In recent years, the application of large-scale energy storage system(ESS) in power grid has shown explosive growth. China has successfully built a number of grid-side ESS projects. The ESS has a variety of application scenarios in grid-side connection, which can give full play to its advantages of quick response and high operating efficiency. In this paper, a collaborative scheduling strategy of distributed ESSs are proposed for regional grid with high proportion of renewable energy including photovoltaic(PV) and wind power. Based on the day-ahead load and the renewable energy power prediction curve, the ESSs adopt the multi-point distributed access method, and make the system operating cost and the voltage deviation minimum as the objective function. The large M method is used to linearize the nonlinear variables multiplied by integer variables and continuous variables respectively, and to transform the multi-objective optimization problem of nonlinear multi-decision variables into a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Finally, the effectiveness is verified by simulation based on IEEE 9 node system. The results show that the access of distributed ESS in regional grid can effectively promote the consumption of renewable energy and improve the system voltage level.

articleTitle: Impact of the accuracy of NWP wind speed forecasts on wind power forecasting
abstract: Accurate wind power forecasting (WPF) is an effective way to alleviate the negative effects brought by the integration of large-scale wind power into electricity grid. Most short-term WPF approaches take the mesoscale Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) results as input to achieve high accuracy. However, the deviation of input NWP wind speed (WS) becomes a major source of WPF error, and the deviation of NWP WS are amplified at different levels in different WPF processes. Therefore, knowing about the impacts of NWP WS accuracy on WPF results will contribute to the improvement of WPF system. Two WPF models based on statistical algorithm and physical Computational Fluid Dynamics method were established respectively. The low-fidelity mesoscale NWP WS, high-fidelity measured WS and medium-fidelity corrected NWP WS with the same time-stamps were separately adopted as the input of WPF models. Via the error analysis of various combinations of input data and forecasting models, results show that the accuracy of forecasting power is proportional to that of input WS. Compared with taking the low-fidelity WS as input, the medium-fidelity inputs could reduce the annual forecasting error by 11% and 10.3% in average for statistical and physical models separately, while more than 15% for the high-fidelity inputs.

articleTitle: Technical challenges of integrating high proportion distributed photovoltaic power into medium DC grid
abstract: With rapid development of distributed photovoltaic (DPV) in most regions, integrating into medium DC power grids is a new efficient way to increase new energy consumption, while the research and engineering practice in this field are still at the initial stage. Based on the instance summaries of completed project, the challenges of integrating high proportion DPV into medium DC grid can be summarized as follows: Topology design with multi-port converts used, critical electronics equipment development used in MVDC, stability analysis of large amount of electronics components interaction with insufficient of traditional method, absence of standards for integrated design guiding practical projects. Considering the economic and technology factors given, three topologies with proposed multi-port converters are given. Besides usual stability analysis methods based on the impendence and state space, applicability of little or large single analysis are discussed. Further studies that can be conducted relevant to high proportion of DPV integrating into developed MVDC system are finally proposed. All these researches can be possible reference for the studies being implemented by the author's team.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control based power flow control strategy of EV DC fast charging station including distributed PV generation and hybrid energy storage systems
abstract: This paper proposes a topology of electric vehicle (EV) DC fast charging station (FCS) considering the access and applications of distributed PV (DPV) generation (such as rooftop PV, carport PV and building integrated PV) and hybrid energy storage systems (HESS), all the PV generation systems, hybrid energy storage systems and EV DC chargers are connected to a common DC bus in the way of plug and play. Considering the state of charge of super-capacitor energy storage system and power flow variation rate of DC bus, a fuzzy control based power flow control strategy (namely an optimal power allocation strategy between battery and super-capacitor (SC) according to the variation of PV output power, power dispatch order of AC distribution network and EV fast charging power) is designed to achieve the maximum utilization of DPV and guarantee the safe and stable operation of EV DC fast charging station. Simulation results in Matlab/Simulink verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy, which can improve the voltage stability of DC bus and control flexibility of power flow.

articleTitle: Chance-constrained optimization for multi-energy hub system with dynamic thermal rating
abstract: The energy hub is an essential concept for coordinating multiple distributed energy resources at the local level in future sustainable networks. However, the increasing penetration of renewable generations bring severe uncertainty to the energy hub modelling and dispatch. This paper resolves the optimal operation of energy hubs with notable amount of uncertain renewable energy resources, aiming to reduce the network investment by exploiting the potential of dynamic thermal rating (DTR) methodology for interconnection branches. It will first model the generation and demand uncertainties within the energy hubs that are weather dependent (i.e. wind, solar, temperature). The DTR model is developed based on real-time weather measurement across a year. Then, a chance-constrained optimal power flow is proposed to fully consider both the positive and negative impact of weather uncertainties on the energy transmission between adjacent energy hubs. The problem is formulated as a multi-period stochastic problem with the objective to minimize the total generation cost of an interconnected energy hub system. The proposed stochastic problem is transformed into an equivalent deterministic problem with the chance constraint translating to deterministic constraint by adopting the Cornish-Fisher expansion method. The developed model is extensively illustrated on a three-hub system with the interior-point method, and it also demonstrates that the proposed method has the ability to significantly improve the efficiency for multi energy integration at the lowest costs.

articleTitle: Improved vector current control for grid side converter in PMSG wind turbine with fault tolerance capability
abstract: Grid side converter (GSC) of permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) based wind turbine face challenges of D.C link over-voltage suppression, reactive current injection, and fluctuations in active power delivery during grid faults. The performance of conventional vector current controller (VCC) of GSC is degraded during grid disturbances due to poor transient response and inability of PLL to precisely track grid voltage angle. This paper presents improved VCC derived from direct power control (DPC) and open-switch fault tolerance control for GSC of PMSG wind turbine. Instead of PLL and Park's transformation for obtaining synchronous rotating frame control structure, the cost effective control technique employs the instantaneous active and reactive power and Clarke's transformation. Therefore, the control framework of overall system is simplified due to the absence of PLL. In this paper, a 2-level GSC is modelled and simulated using Matlab/Simulink for the proposed control method. Grid fault conditions are examined in context of FRT capability and power quality characteristics. Furthermore, typical power switch fault conditions are also injected to test the fault tolerance capability of the control technique. Simulation results show the proposed control technique is promising to achieve system stability during different operating states.

articleTitle: Load forecasting model and day-ahead operation strategy for city-located EV quick charge stations
abstract: Charging demands of electric vehicles (EVs) are sharply increasing due to the rapid development of EVs. Hence, reliable and convenient quick charge stations are required to respond to the needs of EV drivers. Due to the uncertainty of EV charging loads, load forecasting becomes vital for the operation of quick charge stations to formulate the day-ahead plan. In this paper, based on trip chain theory and EV user behaviour, an EV charging load forecasting model is established for quick charge station operators. This model is capable of forecasting the charging demand of a city-located quick charge station during the next day, where the MonteCarlo simulation method is applied. Furthermore, based on the forecasting model, a day-ahead profit-oriented operation strategy for such stations is derived. The simulation results support the effectiveness of this forecasting model and the operation strategy. The conclusions of this paper are as follows: 1) The charging load forecasting model ensures operators to grasp the feature of the charging load of the next day. 2) The revenue of the quick charge station can be dramatically increased by applying the proposed day-head operation strategy.

articleTitle: MILP model for annual power and energy balance of hydro-thermal-wind power system considering RPS mechanism
abstract: As more mandatory policies including Renewable Energy Portfolio Standard (RPS) in China have been introduced to promote renewable generations, traditional power balancing models may become no longer applicable to economically satisfy such ambitious goals. From the perspective of Chinese provincial power grid companies, proper scheduling could increase the penetration of renewable energy sources so as to meeting the urgent RPS requirements. In order to economically schedule annual power generations with consideration of RPS requirements and safety constraints, this paper proposes an annual power and energy balancing model of hydro-thermal-wind power system. The model aims to minimize the cost of power generation under the implementation of the RPS mechanism in China. Regional power grid's power balance constraints, the RPS constraints, hydropower monthly coordination as well as safety constraints including the operational characteristic constraints of hydropower, thermal power and wind power generator units have been considered. The model is formulated as mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem, which is solved by CPLEX. Based on the data of a certain provincial power grid, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Modelling and operation optimization of electricity-gas-heat integrated energy system considering demand response and wind penetration
abstract: With the increasing proportion of wind power generation, the integrated energy system (IES) with unified planning and dispatching of various kinds of energy considering high wind penetration has been put forward. This paper establishes detailed models of a distribution level electricity-gas-heat IES and proposes a rolling operation optimization strategy for the IES considering multi-energy demand response and wind penetration. Firstly, the detailed network model of the electricity-gas-heat IES with linearization techniques is presented as a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Secondly, the multi-energy demand response models provided by the shiftable loads and multi-energy convertible loads in the IES are established. Thirdly, based on the uncertainty of the wind power, the short-term wind power forecast data is utilized, and a rolling operation optimization strategy of the IES with multi-energy demand response is presented. Finally, the feasibility and benefits of the multi-energy demand response for wind power accommodation and cost reduction in the IES are verified through case studies.

articleTitle: Grid balancing with a large-scale electrolyser providing primary reserve
abstract: As the share of renewable energy sources increases, the grid frequency becomes more unstable. Therefore, grid balancing services will become more important in the future. Dedicated devices can be installed close to the point where off-shore wind farms are connected to the transmission grid on land. There, it can be used to attenuate power variations, reduce congestion and offer grid balancing. These ancillary services can create significant economic revenue. In this paper, the provision of primary reserve by means of a large hydrogen electrolyser of 25 MW is investigated for the specific case of the Belgian transmission system. The electrolyser is used to convert water and excess power to hydrogen gas, which is injected into the natural gas grid. The revenue for Frequency Containment Reserve (FCR) provision is analysed on a techno-economic model, including capital costs, operational costs, the revenue of the generated hydrogen and oxygen products and the ancillary service income. The revenue depends strongly on the contracted power-band. Therefore, it is optimised to yield maximum revenue. The results show that providing FCR creates a considerable revenue. Therefore, a large electrolyser can be a good candidate to buffer excess renewable energy into green gas while simultaneously providing grid support.

articleTitle: Simulation research of wind turbine frequency modulation based on different wind power penetration levels
abstract: With the increase of the capacity of wind power, the pressure of frequency modulation by conventional synchronous generator gradually aggravates and wind farm to provide frequency modulation become a concern in the power industry. Wind turbine's inertial control is one of the ways to provide frequency modulation, which will release the rotational inertia through additional controls. But the frequency response performance of inertial frequency modulation by wind turbine under different wind power penetration levels is not fully studied at present. Therefore, this paper firstly discusses the wind turbine active power characteristics and simulation model based on reserve power frequency modulation and inertial control frequency modulation, and then carried out simulations to analyses the response of wind turbine with inertial control in frequency decline event, at last, frequency response of power system based on three types of frequency modulation under wind power penetration levels between 5%∼50% is analyzed in detail, include conventional reserve power frequency modulation, inertial frequency modulation, and the combined frequency modulation. The case study shows that inertial frequency modulation performance are various under different wind power penetrations, it has good effect on the grid frequency nadir under relatively low wind penetration levels, but not in the high wind power penetration levels, in high penetration levels the combined frequency modulation can be adopted to reduce the inertial control's negative impact.

articleTitle: Improvement of frequency stability in microgrids integrated with electric vehicles based virtual inertia control
abstract: Renewable Energy Sources (RESs) in Microgrids (MGs) are increasing quickly and extremely penetrated. Electric Vehicles (EVs) are considered one of the RESs that can have important impact on MGs during their charging and discharging procedures. Despite RESs merits, there are some constraints which can limit them such as, reducing system inertia by replacing synchronous generators with a large quantity of RESs causing adverse impacts for the frequency stability of MG. Hence, this study proposes the development of a robust virtual inertia controller-based coefficient diagram method (CDM) in MGs integrated with RESs and EVs, by virtually inserting a certain amount of inertia into the control loop and thus stabilizing the frequency stability during high penetration of RESs. The efficacy and robustness of the proposed controller are determined together with various perturbations and parametric uncertainties and compared to optimal PI controller utilizing MATLAB/Simulink. The comparison research endorsed that in all test instances, the CDM controller had preferred dynamic reactions to regulate frequency and disruption decrease over the PI controller. As a result, the stability of the frequency is enhanced and verified that the proposed virtual inertia controller based CDM has the ability to substantially support a low inertia MG for various contingencies.

articleTitle: Stackelberg game based fast charging service fee price model in consideration of electric vehicles' promotion
abstract: Through analysing the development process of fast charging industry, this paper points out that grid-owned charging stations occupy a dominant position in fast charging market, benefiting from their "integration advantage", while third-party stations enter the market and follow the price set by grid-owned stations. With the demand curve in fast charging market, a stackelberg game exists and can be formulated into a two-layer optimization model. The objective of the lower problem is to maximize third-party stations' profits, while the upper problem maximizes grid-owned stations' profits in consideration of social welfare, including electric vehicles' promotion. Current charging price includes two parts: electricity price and a service fee, while the latter is still lacking an explicit price model. The price model of fast charging price including a service fee is proposed through solving the stackelberg game. The conclusions are as follows: 1) The entry of third-party stations can benefit the cut of costumers' cost and the improvement of social welfare. 2) The charging service fee should be regulated in consideration of electric vehicles' promotion based on the model. 3) The proposed price model is more practical in dealing with varying electricity price compared with a fixed service fee.

articleTitle: Integrated modelling and planning of regional integrated energy systems based on exergy analysis
abstract: The planning of a regional integrated energy system (RIES) involving multiple energy forms such as electricity/gas/ heating/cooling has always been a complex problem. Improving the efficiency of energy utilization is an important task for RIES planning. The traditional energy efficiency only takes into account the change of energy in quantity, but ignores that in quality, which is impossible to accurately measure the energy utilization level of a RIES. In this paper, the exergy efficiency considering both the quantity and the quality of energy is proposed. First, the concept of energy quality coefficient (EQC) is defined to quantify the differences among different energy forms, and the exergy efficiency calculation method of a RIES is proposed. Secondly, an annual total cost (ATC) of RIES is modelled considering the life cycle cost over the selected time horizon. And then the multi-objective planning model with objectives of economy and exergy efficiency is proposed, which considers both planning and operation. A RIES in Guangzhou is selected as the case study to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Equivalent energy storage of building with thermal inertia in integrated energy system
abstract: Integrated energy system is an important scene for improving the use of renewable energy. The thermal inertia obviously influences the energy distribution in system. Generally the thermal inertia is considered as a characteristic in simulation for better precision. This paper presents another view of considering the thermal inertia as a virtual energy storage device. Acceptable temperature tolerance of building could be equivalent to the heat storage ability. So this kind of storage device could also be controlled and evaluated by traditional battery strategies, and save the investment of expensive battery system. The equivalent model is proposed in this paper, and characteristic of the equivalent storage device is given. Results show that the thermal inertia of building could be a considerable part of energy storage system, which could improve the performance of integrated energy system with no extra cost. Comparison with existing methods shows good effectivity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A comprehensive decision-making method for coordinated transmission and distribution network planning
abstract: The expansion planning of transmission and distribution networks is usually investigated separately in both research and practical programs. However, the split planning method results in redundant expansion investment since the coordination between the power systems of adjacent voltage levels is neglected. In this paper, a co-planning model is proposed, where lines and substations in multiple-level power grid are allocated as a whole rather than in a sequential manner. In addition, an evaluation system is established to comprehensively assess the planning schemes. The coefficients of normalized and weighted indices are determined by entropy weight method. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is utilized to solve this nonlinear programming problem. Compared with the complicated mathematical optimization, PSO algorithm is more straightforward and simpler. The simulation of a 13-bus system is taken to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm. The results indicate that the planning scheme designed in a coordinated way is more economical and coordinated compared to that in a separate way. The proposed model and algorithm can enlighten the electricity practitioners to improve the current planning pattern for multi-level power system.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of compensated modulation based MMC-HVDC for wind farm integration
abstract: In this paper, the stability analysis of the compensated modulation based MMC-HVDC connected wind farms is carried out, where the impedance-based analytical approach is applied. The ac-side impedance models of the MMC with compensated and direct modulation are derived, respectively, and their impedance characteristics are compared. The impact of the two modulation modes on the stability of the MMC-HVDC with the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farm is then analysed and the time-domain simulations are done to validate the theoretical analysis. The results indicate that the MMC-HVDC with compensated modulation is conducive to the stability of wind farm integration.

articleTitle: A survey on social media to enhance the cyber-physical-social resilience of smart grid
abstract: Smart sensor that enables power grid resiliency at distribution network is a very expensive solution and its implementation has been very sluggish. Social media has great potential to become an alternate abstract information channel that can replace/reinforce smart sensor capabilities towards a more resilient power grid. In this paper, we present a survey on the progress of utilizing social media as a platform to extract and analyse abstract data to produce intelligent information. This information can be utilized to plan and implement resources towards power grid resiliency from micro level (consumers) to macro level (cities/states). This paper discusses the reliability of social sensors, various concepts relating to social media and their implementation to solve problems, and how we can develop a framework based on the social media towards a resilient power grid. The realization of social media framework for information will benefit as robust communication and control channels that can be used together with prediction models to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of system operators' decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on real-time simulation modelling of Zhangbei renewable energy base based on RTDS
abstract: The real-time simulation modelling of large-scale renewable energy base is the key for the dynamic stability analysis of renewable energy based power systems. In China, the Zhangbei renewable energy base has huge installed capacity of renewable energy, including wind power and photovoltaics (PV), which will be connected to the Beijing power grid through flexible high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system. In order to investigate the dynamic stability of the flexible HVDC transmission system with the Zhangbei renewable energy base, the real-time simulation model of the whole interconnected system is built based on real-time digital simulator (RTDS). There are more than 15 wind/PV power plants in Zhangbei renewable energy base. Due to the limited resources of RTDS, a simplified scheme for the Zhangbei large-scale renewable energy cluster is put forward in this paper, where the aggregated model based on the multiplier transformer is used for each wind/PV power plant and the topology of the renewable energy base is considered. Furthermore, several RTDS racks are interconnected via optical fibres to increase the maximum number of the computing nodes. Finally, the validity of the proposed modelling method is verified by both frequency-domain analysis and time-domain simulations, where the transient characteristics, such as low-voltage/high-voltage ride-through, are simulated and analysed.

articleTitle: Research on maximum power point tracking control method of wind turbine based on corrected wind speed
abstract: The maximum power point tracking control of wind turbines is the essential measure to improve wind energy capture efficiency in low wind speed regions, and is crucial for improving wind turbines generating efficiency. The input wind speed of the maximum power point tracking control model should be the head wind speed at hub height, and the commonly used wind speed from nacelle anemometer will introduce a large error. In order to reduce the introduction error, the maximum power point tracking control method of wind turbines based on corrected wind speed is proposed. In this method, the wind wheel unit flow tube model based on Betz theory is used to correct the wind speed from nacelle anemometer as head wind speed, and the maximum power point tracking control model of wind turbines is constructed based on the corrected wind speed. The 2MW wind turbine model was constructed and simulated in Simulink/Matlab environment to verify the availability and suitability of the proposed model. The simulation results show that the proposed model can effectively improve the maximum power point tracking control accuracy of wind turbines and has good applicability.

Author Keywords: WIND WHEEL UNIT FLOW TUBE MODEL

articleTitle: Combination forecasting method of short-term power for dispersed wind farm
abstract: Recently, power consumption and delivery issues become more prominent in large-scale centralized wind power integration scenario. In contrast, dispersed wind power systems, which can be consumed locally and connected nearby, have attracted widespread attention in China. To ensure the reliability of grid connection for dispersed wind power, the establishment of wind power forecasting is essential. However, the influence of buildings on forecasting cannot be ignored as the position of dispersed wind power is closed to the load. Meanwhile, the lack of anemometer tower in dispersed wind farm has also increased the difficulty of power prediction. Considering various environmental factors, such as location and temperature, and historical power data, this paper firstly establishes three wind power forecasting model based on linear regression, support vector machine and neural network method. Secondly, a combination forecasting method for short-term power wind power is proposed by combining the three prediction models above and further taken as high-precision wind power predictions. Simulation results show that the proposed power forecasting method can comprehensively consider the influence of location and temperature as well as historical data. Besides, the accuracy of the combined forecasting model is higher than that of every single model.

articleTitle: Resilience-oriented multi-energy complementary microgrid robust optimal operation strategy considering the uncertainty
abstract: This paper proposes a novel resilience-oriented optimal operation strategy for multi-energy complementary (MEC) microgrid. The objectives in the proposed optimal strategy consist of the resilience, the operation cost and the total pollutant emissions. Since distributed energy resources (DER) exist in the MEC microgrid, the problem formulated is a multi-objective optimization considering the uncertainty wherein the resilience is maximized while the cost is minimized. Thus, it can be solved as a min-max dual robust optimization problem. Benders decomposition (BD) is employed to decouple it, then improved simulated annealing algorithm (SAA) is deployed to search the min/max value. Compared with other robust optimal model, the proposed strategy can be applied in the MEC microgrid as well as consider the resiliency. The case with photovoltaic (PV) panels, wind turbines (WT), combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system, ground source heat pump (GSHP) and different loads demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed optimal operation strategy.

articleTitle: An improved droop control strategy with double compensation for DC microgrid
abstract: The droop control applied in dc microgrid needs to solve two major problems, namely, reducing the bus voltage deviation and improving the current sharing accuracy. From the perspective of solving the above problems, an improved droop control strategy based on double compensation mechanism has been proposed in this paper, which includes a voltage deviation compensator and a current sharing accuracy compensator. Specifically, the fuzzy algorithm is adopted in the voltage deviation compensator to reduce the bus voltage deviation. The current sharing accuracy compensator utilizes the information interaction between the adjacent units to improve the current sharing accuracy. Essentially, the proposed control strategy improves the system performance through the translation of the traditional fixed droop curve. In order to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy, a dc microgrid model is built on MATLAB/Simulink for simulations, and a prototype is built for experiments. Finally, the simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control strategy can effectively reduce the bus voltage deviation and improve the current sharing accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on uncertain risk prevention strategy of virtual power plant
abstract: The operation of virtual power plants often faces a large number of uncertain variables, including market prices, new energy power and load. These uncertain variables have caused the virtual power plant to lose load and to reduce its economic benefits. To avoid these risks, virtual power plants often adopt conservative operation strategies. In order to evaluate the degree of the risks brought by the uncertain variables to virtual power plants, this paper first establishes a virtual power plant loss load function, the regulation performance calculation function and the virtual power plant operation profit function. Secondly, based on the Value at Risk method and the three functions mentioned above, this paper proposes a conditional value at risk function of the virtual power plant to evaluate the loss of the virtual power plant under extreme risk conditions. Finally, based on the Conditional Value at Risk method, a virtual power plant operation decision model considering uncertain risk prevention strategies is proposed. The example shows that the proposed model can effectively reduce the probability of the uncertain risk of the virtual power plant and reduce the loss of the virtual power plant under extreme risk conditions.

articleTitle: Method of T-connection line parameter estimation in distribution network based on PMU measurement data
abstract: Real-time analysis of the variation of distribution network line parameters is of great significance to improve the analysis and operation of distribution network. PMU technologies have been applied widely, which provides abundant synchronous measurement data for the distribution network line parameters estimation. In the view of widely existing T-connection line mode in distribution network, a method of T-connection line parameter estimation method based on PMU measurement data is proposed. Considering the asymmetries of three phase line load in distribution network, the single-phase line parameter estimation model based on phase component is used for T-connection line parameter estimation in this paper. The objective function is constructed based on least squares method by the PMU measured phasor voltage and phasor current information. And the Newton iteration method is used to solve the nonlinear equations to estimate the exact line parameters. The dynamic simulation data are produced by PSCAD, which is used to verify the feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: U.S. green power market experience and its enlightenment to China
abstract: As the country developing green power the fastest in the world, the U.S. green power market emerged in the 1990s and has experienced exploration and practice for more than 20 years. Through the promotion of state governments and active participation of market players, a market structure has emerged with flexible and diverse procurement methods in which compliance and voluntary markets coexist. Firstly, this paper analyzes the development of the U.S. green power market. Secondly, research has been carried out on two market types: green power and voluntary trading based on the Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) and the U.S. green power tracking mechanism, and on the basis of which this paper further analyzes the cases of U.S. green power trading.
