Finally, it puts forward the enlightenment to China by considering the construction of green power market in China.

articleTitle: Study on the maximum access power scale of East China's Jiangsu power grid when having large scale HVDCs
abstract: This paper gives the acquiring method of the maximum receiving power capability in Jiangsu power grid. The indicator to judge the most serious failures on the important transmission section is put forward, which is used to identify the most serious failures in adjusting the power flow when getting the maximum receiving power capability, so as to save the simulation time. Based on the proposed method, this paper analyses the maximum receiving power scale of the present and future power grid of Jiangsu province, and points out that when the receiving power continues to increase, the restriction sections are mainly in the power grid transmission section from outer region to Jiangsu and the Jiangsu internal 500kV transmission section from Suzhou to Jiangsu. After the formation of UHV AC ring network, the UHV AC lines sent to East China are radially connected, the power of each channel is distributed in two directions in East China ring network, and the multi-channel superposition will lead to different flow distributions of the ring network, and the weak link will also shift. If the grid can be strengthened freely, Jiangsu power grid can increase the receiving power scale, but there are ceilings, Jiangsu's electricity scale can be increased by a limited extent.

articleTitle: Influence of virtual inertia in wind turbines on large scale power grid frequency characteristics
abstract: The penetration rate of wind turbines (WTs) has continually increased in large-scale power grid. These WTs, which do not have inertial response, potentially weaken the inertia of power system. To address this problem, researchers have proposed virtual inertia control for WTs. However, only a few studies have investigated the effect of such virtual inertia on improving frequency characteristics of large-scale power grid. In this paper, the power grid frequency characteristics have been investigated from three way: analysis of practical frequency drop incident, typical examples simulation and mathematical model. Based on the investigation results, the influence of inertia support in wind turbines on the frequency drop characteristics in large-scale power grid. Finally, the influence of inertial response on primary frequency modulation in WT was analysed. The result indicated that different virtual inertia control of WTs show variable influences on frequency stability. Moreover, some virtual inertia methods of WTs may contribute to negative damping for frequency characteristics of large-scale power grid.

articleTitle: Research on HVAC's operation strategy for frequency regulation under integrated coordination control
abstract: Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning (HVAC), as a typical flexible load due to thermal inertia, has numerous controllable variables and swift power regulation rates, which qualifies it to become an excellent frequency regulation (FR) resource. According to the response rates associated with different control variables and power system's FR demand on time scale, we use set point regulation (SPR) method to involve HVAC in secondary FR (SFR); market-based control (MBC) is used to allocate SFR capacity, guaranteeing the consistency of consumers' comfort. Meanwhile, we use tap position regulation (TPR) method to participate in primary FR (PFR), and add virtual inertia control (VIC) to traditional virtual droop control (VDC), promoting PFR performance. Simulation of frequency in a single-area system with renewable energy generation is carried out. The results show that SPR and TPR can excellently match on time scales, dramatically reduce frequency fluctuation amplitude and narrow down the range of frequency deviation. In addition, virtual inertia control can effectively restrain frequency oscillation in a severe disturbance situation, which significantly improves power system's stability.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of virtual synchronous generator for DFIG wind turbine generator
abstract: With the rapid development of the wind power generation, the penetration rate of wind power is gradually increasing, which affects the stable operation of the power system. The DFIG wind turbine generator can realize decoupling control of output active and reactive power by vector transformation control. However, under this power control, wind turbines do not have the electromechanical transient characteristics like synchronous generators for supporting the stable operation of the power system. Virtual synchronous generator technology can make the wind power system reflect the operation mechanism and external characteristics of traditional synchronous generators to improve the stability of power system. This paper builds a generic simulation model of current source type DFIG wind turbine generator based on VSG technology, which can simulate a series of VSG behaviors including virtual inertia control, damping control, primary frequency control, reactive power control and fault ride through. The developed simulation model is also validated comparing to the actual wind turbine field testing data, which shows accurate and reliable simulation results. The developed simulation model can provide theoretical and model basis for studying VSG technology and grid integration characteristics.

articleTitle: Mechanism underlying constant amplitude oscillation of grid-tied voltage source converters
abstract: Small-signal stability is one of the main issues for the safe operation of power system. The traditional studies mainly focus on stability determination of power system, but the issue after system oscillation divergence is seldom involved, which may cause system collapse and trigger protective actions, or oscillate at a constant amplitude with a certain frequency. In this paper, the mechanism of small-signal instability diverging to constant amplitude oscillation (CAO) is studied for grid connected converters, which only considers the nonlinear factors introduced by phase-locked loop (PLL) controller. Based on the nonlinear analysis method of Lyapunov exponent, the CAO is caused by the nonlinear limit cycles, which is investigated for the first time, and the period of nonlinear limit cycle dose not correspond to the unstable modal frequency of small-signal analysis. When the system oscillates stably with constant amplitude, the system model cannot be described by linear-time invariable (LTI) model in constant speed reference frame of base frequency, then the linear-time periodic (LTP) theory is introduced into this case. Based on the Floquet theory, the eigenvalue locus of LTP model in time-domain illustrates the process of unstable system at constant steady-state operating point diverging to a stable system at steady-state trajectory. Finally, the validity of the analysis is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Improving operation feasibility of low-voltage distribution network by phase-switching devices
abstract: High penetration of residential photovoltaic (PV) in low-voltage distribution networks (LVDN) makes the unbalance issue more sever due to the asymmetry of generation/load characteristic in different phases, and may lead to infeasible operation of the whole network. Phase switching device (PSD), which can switch connected phase of residential load as required, is a viable and efficient equipment to help address this issue. This paper, based on three-phase power flow (TUPF) formulation, aims to investigate the benefit of PSD on improving the operation feasibility of LVDN. The linear model of TUPF with PSD is presented to effectively take the flexible device into account, which can be conveniently used to seek the PSD positions that lead to a viable operation strategy of original problem when infeasibility is reported by traditional iterationbased algorithm. Case study based on a practical LVDN in Australia demonstrates the efficacy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Protection adaptability analysis in VSC-HVDC-connected offshore wind farm system
abstract: Voltage-Source Converter High-Voltage Direct Current (VSC-HVDC) transmission is the most important direction of technical development for offshore wind farms. A large number of power electronic devices of VSC-HVDC-connected offshore wind farms integration system, which leads to the unique fault characteristics different from conventional synchronous systems. With a fault on AC side transmission lines, the wind farm and the VSC-HVDC together provide faulted current, whose amplitude and phase will be decided by their different control strategies collectively. Thus, the performance of traditional protection will be affected. Based on analysis of fault characteristics, this paper analyses the performance of conventional protection, such as the distance protection, pilot protection and zero sequence current protection. Based on protection adaptability, suggestions of the protection configuration in the VSC-HVDC-connected offshore wind farms integration system are put forward. The simulation results in Pscad/Emtdc reflects the correctness of the theoretical analysis on protection adaptability.

articleTitle: Real time coordinated optimization dispatch model for AC/DC hybrid distribution network
abstract: With the gradual increase of the penetration rate of new energy, the cyber physical system paves a new way for real time dispatch, rational planning and effective utilization of new energy. This paper establishes a dynamic multi-agent real-time coordinated control model for the framework of a typical AC/DC hybrid distribution network and proposes the distributed algorithm. The algorithm includes two parts: optimized dispatch and coordinated control. Firstly, by dispatching and optimizing primary energy, large-scale use and sharing of distributed renewable energy can be realized, energy supply cost can be reduced, and the reliability of energy supply can be improved. Energy Internet provides powerful support for power systems, heating systems, and other major energy networks. Then a coordinated control model based on a dynamic multi-agent system is established to eliminate load fluctuation quickly and efficiently, maintaining the stability of the energy internet. Finally, multi-agent containment control algorithm was applied in the voltage control to guarantee high power quality. According to the actual operation situation of physical devices, the adjustment term serves as a feedback to do real-time correction, in order to make the results satisfy all constraints. Simulation results were presented to demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis on the VSC based controller for damping SSR in multi-generator system
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the power system and the construction of the series compensator devices in Northwest China, interactions between the generators and the power grid become more complicated while the problem of sub-synchronous resonance (SSR) is more prominent. To deal with this problem, a controller named subsynchronous resonance dynamic suppressor (SSRDS) based on voltage source converter (VSC) for damping SSR of multi-generator system is proposed. Meanwhile, this study also presents an analysis of the control strategy of SSRDS and the method of connecting the power grid. The damping characteristics of SSRDS and the interaction between SSRDS and grid are analyzed by the complex torque coefficient method. A detailed electro-magnetic transient simulation model based on the expansion topology of future Jinjie Power Plant in northern China is established to verify the analytical results. The results show that the proposed control strategy can effectively suppress SSR in the system of six generators and six modes through one-to-many control method. Compared to the traditional thyristor controlled reactor-subsynchronous damping controller (TCR-SSDC), the controller can achieve the same effect with a smaller capacity, a faster response and less harmonic pollution.

articleTitle: Pilot protection principle for HVDC transmission lines based on current correlation
abstract: Conventional current differential protection for high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission lines has shortages in tripping speed and adaptability to fault resistance. A pilot protection scheme based on current correlation is proposed. Based on the impedance-frequency characteristic of the DC filter, the theoretical analysis on the fault components network of internal and external faults on the dc transmission line shows that, under an internal fault, the specific-frequency fault components of currents at both ends of the dc line show a strong positive correlation, whereas for external faults, they show strong negative correlation. Thus, it can be utilized to discriminate internal faults from external ones. Simulation results show that the proposed protection scheme is simple, has less computation, and can identify faults quickly and reliably. Besides, it can identify internal high-resistance faults and is not affected by the DC line distributed capacitor.

articleTitle: An improved cumulant-based probabilistic energy flow computation method for integrated electricity and natural gas systems
abstract: Intermittent renewable energies and fluctuant energy demands introduce uncertainties into planning and operation of the integrated electricity and natural gas system (IENGS). This paper proposes an improved cumulant-based probabilistic energy flow (PEF) computation method. First, a cumulant-based PEF computation model for IENGS is developed with consideration of frequency regulation characteristics of the electricity system, three couplings (gas-fired generators, P2G units and electric-driven compressors), and correlations among input random variables. Second, an improved K-means clustering technique is proposed to reduce linearization errors of the cumulant-based PEF caused by large fluctuations of input random variables. The improved K-means clustering technique incorporates the effects of different scales and sensitivities of different input random variables. Base on the input random variable samples in each cluster, the cumulant-based PEF is conducted with improved accuracy. Finally, the proposed method is examined using an integrated electricity and natural gas test system that is comprised of IEEE 39-bus system and Belgian high-calorific natural gas system. Compared with Monte Carlo simulation (MCS), multi-linear Monte Caro simulation (MLMCS), the cumulant method (CM) without clustering techniques, and the method of combined CM and the conventional K-means (CMCK), the proposed method achieves better performance with consideration of both accuracy and efficiency.

Author Keywords: Integrated electricity and natural gas system (IENGS)

articleTitle: Security-constrained transmission expansion planning considering high proportion of wind power and natural disasters
abstract: The primary goal for system planners is to ensure the safety of power systems under uncertainty. Besides the intermittency of increasing renewable energy and load fluctuation, the natural disaster of high-risk also poses a critical challenge to system planners. Pre-considering the vulnerable parts of the power system during the planning stage and taking appropriate measures to play a key role in reducing the losses caused by natural disasters. The aim of this paper is to consider the impact of natural disasters on the power grid. First of all, taking each transmission branch as a starting point and considering the correlation between the outage of transmission lines, a correlation evaluation index is proposed to determine the final scheme of line outages. Furthermore, the N-1 security criterion is embedded into constraints and thus a security-constrained transmission expansion planning (TEP) model under uncertainty is formulated. Computational studies on the modified IEEE 24-bus reliability test system (RTS) validate the effectiveness of the proposed planning method.

articleTitle: Interharmonics current mitigation using DC-APF for high power extremely low frequency transmission system
abstract: The operation of high power extremely low frequency transmission system (HPELFTS) causes interharmonics current presenting in the power grid (PG), which seriously reduces the PG's power quality. This is not meet the requirements for interharmonics in public power grids. To solve the issue, a buck DC active power filter (DC-APF) paralleled in DC side is proposed to cut off the propagation path of interharmonics current from load to PG. Through the detection of the scene, theoretical modeling to reproduce the situation of the scene, the interharmonic suppression strategy is proposed, and the simulation analysis and experimental verification are carried out. The results show that the buck DC-APF can effectively cut off the propagation path of interharmonics current and makes the interharmonics current drop up to 40 dB and make the HPELFTS meet the grid access standard, which is the access standard required by the power grid.

articleTitle: Economic feasibility analysis of using battery energy storage to reduce renewable generation curtailment in CSG
abstract: Based on real data, this paper studies the economic feasibility of using battery energy storage (BES) to reduce curtailment of renewable energy generation in China Southern Power Grid (CSG). Firstly, areas in CSG with most renewable generation curtailment are identified, and new methods to estimate and correct the abandoned renewable power are proposed in this paper, since the conventional model machine method is no longer applicable in highland mountains. Secondly, the necessary installed capacities of BES and power conversion system (PCS) are dimensioned based on emulated operations of BES. Finally, the investments of necessary BES capacity to accommodate abandoned renewable power and its payback periods are calculated. It is found that, in CSG, there is no scenario where BES is competitive to facilitate renewable energy accommodation due to low utilization. The initial investment of BES is huge and the payback period is very long. In comparison, most of abandoned wind and solar power could have been accommodated by building additional substations or altering operation mode of existing substations with much lower cost. In the future, BES could become competitive when curtailment of renewable generation is more evenly distributed through a year and the cost of batteries declines.

articleTitle: State evaluation method and correction of oil-immersed transformer in the renewable power grid based on big data analysis
abstract: The state evaluation of power equipment is an important basis for maintenance scheduling. This paper starts from the performance state data of power transformer and aims to study the matrix model and mathematical analysis method that is applicable to the state parameter system of power equipment in renewable power grid. Different from the traditional threshold deduction method, this paper is more inclined to propose a closed loop model by finding the correlation among the internal key parameters of the system by reducing the dimension of the state matrix and increasing the dimension of iterations. This paper presents the basic state evaluation parameter system from various aspects which are based on the multi-source information of renewable power grid substations. The dimensionality reduction of the matrix is carried out for the criterion matrix of the nature.

articleTitle: Research on collaborative frequency regulation control strategy of wind farm based on decentralized exit
abstract: When the wind turbine adopts the rotor inertia control to participate in grid frequency regulation, it is easy to cause the second frequency drop, which will be more serious when applied to the wind farm. To solve this problem, the influence of wind speed on the unit's ultimate support time under the constant power support mode is analyzed quantitatively and wind turbine recovery time is defined. The functional relationship between the unit's support time and recovery time suitable for engineering application is given. A wind farm frequency regulation optimization model aiming at the longest supporting time of all units in the whole station is established, and the wind farm coordinated frequency regulation control strategy based on decentralized exit is proposed, taking full account of capacity differences of units under different working conditions. Simulation examples show that the real-time coordination of the exit of the wind turbine frequency regulation can effectively alleviate the secondary frequency drop problem of a wind farm.

articleTitle: Evaluation of wind power operating capacity credit considering prediction error
abstract: The load-carrying capacity and the stability of wind power generation are different from those of conventional generation. The current evaluation method almost considers the capacity credit of each region as a fixed value, which underestimates the contribution of wind power generation to the power system adequacy. To solve this problem, the wind power continuous output model is proposed in this paper based on the nonparametric joint probability density distribution of prediction error. This model can well describe the wind power output but is complicated. Improved wind power two-state model is developed. Under the condition that expected energy not supplied (EENS) is unchangeable, various wind power operating capacity credit, defined by equivalent firm capacity (EFC), equivalent conventional generation capacity (ECGC) and equivalent load-carrying capability (ELCC), is evaluated by both models with measurements and predictions. It can be observed that the results calculated by the proposed models are similar, and they are more reasonable and effective than the existing models.

articleTitle: CCF early warning method of LCC-HVDC based on XGBoost algorithm
abstract: The lack of analytical mechanism of continuous commutation failure (CCF) process hinders the development of CCF early warning algorithm and further obstructs the coordination strategy of relay protection between AC and DC size in hybrid grid. However, summarizing the protection threshold of CCF in the form of electrical quantity analytically under different fault types is a nontrivial pattern recognition problem. To overcome the difficulty of directly analysing the electromagnetic process of CCF, a statistical learning modelling approach is adapted to propose a CCF warning system, in which XGBoost algorithm was used as the backbone to regress on the relationship between AC/DC electrical quantities and the possibility of the occurrence of CCF. The design of the feature vector in XGBoost-based classifier considers not only the analytical expression of key electrical quantity during single commutation failure but also the important state variable of control system. Additionally, a special data windowing method was proposed to enrich of information encoded by the feature vector while ensuring the speed requirement posed by the protection system. Validation on multi-fault scenes simulation shows that the proposed early warning system can trigger warning signal correctly with sufficiently small measured data required, proving the practicability in engineering practice.

articleTitle: A bilevel planning model for distribution network considering renewable energy consumption
abstract: The key to improve the consumption capacity of renewable energy in the distribution network is to solve the problem of local power grid blockage, which requires the collaborative decision-making of power network operation and planning, that is, the balance planning between the non-network solution and the network solution. In this paper, the planning — operation bilevel optimization model is established by taking the construction time and location of the line and energy storage as decision variables. The planning layer optimizes the total annual cost of the network structure and energy storage to the minimum, while the operational layer optimizes the daily economic scheduling cost. And then the Lagrange multiplier reflecting the marginal benefit is fed back to the planning layer to obtain the planning scheme with the lowest total cost. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed bilevel optimization model.

articleTitle: Arc fault detection and localization in photovoltaic systems based on arc signatures in low impedance paths and its path topology
abstract: Identification and localization of DC arc faults is particularly meaningful for the safety and stability of photovoltaic (PV) system. In order to identify the arc fault and its location accurately and effectively in PV system, an arc fault detection device which helps the system develop proper low impedance path of arc fault is designed. An approach of arc fault detection and localization based on arc characteristics in low impedance path and topological analysis of low impedance one is proposed. Different topologies of low impedance path are formed because of the diversity of location of the arc-fault in the PV system. Once the arc fault occurs, based on the arc fault detection device, the arc signatures in low impedance path are used to distinguish the arc fault in PV system, and the location of the arc fault is identified through analyzing the topology of the low impedance path formed by the arc fault detection device. The effectiveness of the proposed arc fault detection device and approach is validated by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Analysis of high voltage DC transmission network for the future energy needs of Pakistan
abstract: Electricity encompasses a pivotal role in the economic development and social prosperity of a country. Unluckily, Pakistan is facing severe energy crisis, but recently the Government of Pakistan (GoP) has laid foundation of its first renewable energy policy for the development and adoption of renewable generation (RG) and to replenish energy needs. Distributed renewable generation is allocated to the remote areas, distancing it from the load centre (LC), rather than the conventional centralized bulk power generation. In lieu to the aforementioned narrative, distributed energy resources (DER) e.g., PV and wind have gained adequate and well-deserved attention of governments in acknowledgement of their eco-friendly nature. Contrarily, the accentuated penetration of distributed generation to the power system has incorporated several economical and technical glitches. To comprehend these problems, the utilization of high voltage DC (HVDC) transmission has emerged as an ultimate conceivable solution. In this regard, this paper contains a brief discussion on the fundamentals of first HVDC and its implication in Pakistani power sector. Moreover, the potential of DERs for Pakistan is also the subject matter of this paper, so that the implication of HVDC transmission can be apprehended.

articleTitle: A SPWM algorithem with symetrical shoot-through states for Z/quasi-Z source inverters
abstract: A novel PWM algorithm with symmetrical shoot-through states for multiphase Z/quasi-Z source inverters is proposed, which is based on three carriers. Besides the basic triangle carrier, the upper carrier and the lower carrier are respectively constructed by up-shifting and down-shifting the basic carrier; then according to the size of phase modulation wave, the most appropriate carrier is selected to compare it with the modulation wave for switching signal of the phase leg. In half a switching cycle, two symmetrical shoot through intervals are distributed at the transitions from active state to null state, being in conventional null state but not at the centre, which makes the switching times reduced significantly but the output performance almost same as that of SBC PWM. The shoot through of phase leg takes place only in the biggest phase and smallest phase, so that the overlap of shoot through intervals in double carrier PWM will no longer occur in treble carrier PWM. The study demonstrates that treble carrier PWM is the modification of SBC PWM by optimizing the switching sequences, that switching times is reduced significantly, also lower ripple in inductor current and capacitor voltage is got.

articleTitle: Multi-objecive LPV control of wind energy conversion system under wide-scale operating conditions
abstract: Wind energy conversion system (WECS) is essentially a time-varying system with high nonlinear characteristics, which leads to the difficulty of guaranteeing the control performance in a wide-scale operating conditions for the conventional linear control strategies. In this paper, a linear-parameter-varying (LPV) gain-scheduled controller is proposed for variable-speed-variable-pitch wind turbines above rated wind speed, which improves both steady-and dynamic-response performances under wide-scale operating conditions. Firstly, the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> technique is adopted to reduce the rated power tracking errors, while enhancing the robustness against high-frequency turbulence. Secondly, the regional pole placement technique is applied on WECS, which builds the connections to the dynamic response performance. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, the simulation is implemented on the NREL 5 MW wind turbine, which is compared with the conventional local linear control strategy with a full analysis on the related performances.

articleTitle: Design of renewable energy certificates market mechanism under the framework of China's renewable portfolio standards
abstract: Since the adoption of the Feed-in Tariff (FIT) policy in 2006, renewable energy subsidy gap has reached 120 billion in China, the implementation of the Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPS) is urgent. This paper summarizes and compares the experiences of countries that have successfully implemented RPS and proposes a universal timeline of support policies in renewable energy, and points out the reasons for the unsuccessful implementation of the Indian RPS, and gives corresponding advices to the RPS rules of China. Under the existing framework of China's RPS, this paper innovatively designed the Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) market mechanism, and set incentives to induce renewable energy producers to participate in the RECs market transaction. It will gradually transfer the subsidy pressure to the electricity consumption side, and ensure the obligating entity's completion of RPS quota. The content and results of this research are of great significance to the design of the trading mechanism of China's RECs market.

articleTitle: A joint clearing model of energy and auxiliary service market considering flexible load
abstract: The behavior of flexible loads can respond flexibly to price signals, which is of great significance for improving the reliability and market efficiency of power systems. With the development of power market construction in China, the conditions for flexible load to participate in the spot market have been gradually possessed. Considering both the electric energy market and the spare capacity auxiliary service market, this paper establishes a joint clearing model for the energy market and the auxiliary service market considering flexible load, and researches on different combinations of flexible load participation in energy market and alternate market, aiming at the model problem of flexible load participating in the spot market. Through the calculation of examples, the changes of parameters such as the yield of flexible load and the peak-to-valley difference of system load under different scenarios are studied. The results of this paper show that the participation of flexible load in the energy market is conducive to improving the reliability of the system operation, while the participation of flexible load in the standby market is conducive to improving the overall social benefits.

articleTitle: The detection method of wind turbine operation outliers based on muti-dimensional cluster
abstract: The study of wind power often depends on historical operation data. The significance of wind turbine operation data is particularly prominent, especially when the data driven method is widely used and effective. However, due to the equipment failure, human factors and wind curtailments, the quality of the data is poor, affecting wind turbine performance analysis and reducing wind power prediction accuracy. Consequently, research on operation data cleaning methods is extremely urgent. According to the characteristics of outliers, a detection model of operation outliers is proposed based on multi-dimensional clustering method and quartile method. With the purpose of increasing the clustering dimension, wind speed and pitch angle features are extracted and fed into the clustering model to identify the stacked abnormal data. Then quartile method is used to eliminate the scattered outliers around the wind power curve. This paper uses an improved k-means method that automatically obtains the initial centers and number of clustering. A case study indicates that the model presented is efficient to eliminating outliers. Without adjusting parameters for different wind turbines, the cleaning process is completely driven by data, which indicates that the model has strong versatility and can be applied in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Applicability analysis of synchronous condenser and STATCOM in frequency and time domains
abstract: Due to the increasing number of UHVDCs, modern power systems are more likely to incur voltage instability. Dynamic reactive power compensators are one of the most effective solutions to this problem. Applicability analysis of new generation synchronous condenser and static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) in frequency and time domains is analyzed in this paper. Firstly, an effective reactive current gain index is proposed to realize the dynamic response evaluation, via which the characteristics of the two devices are studied in the frequency domain. The analysis includes their amplitude-frequency and phase-frequency characteristics under voltage fluctuation of different frequencies. Based on the current and planning power systems, the two devices' dynamic characteristics are compared in the time domain considering multiple application scenes—such as steady-state and frequency overvoltage restraining in sending-end power systems, decreasing the possibility of simultaneous commutation failure in multiple DC lines, and enhancing transient voltage stability of receiving-end power systems. The results indicate that synchronous condenser is more effective than STATCOM under most scenes. This work is expected to provide important technical instructions in dynamic reactive power compensator selection for power grids under planning, which is conducive to the improvement of security and stability of power grids.

articleTitle: Machine learning based impedance estimation in power system
abstract: A passive machine learning based technique to estimate the impedance of the power grid at the point of common coupling of a converter interfaced distributed generation source is proposed. The proposed method is based on supervised learning and provides a fast and accurate estimation of the grid impedance without adversely impacting the power quality of the system. This method does not need an injection of additional signals to the grid and provides an accurate estimation of the grid impedance. Multi-objective NSGA-II algorithm is used for optimisation and tuning the random forest model for accurate estimation of both R and X The resistive and inductive reactance of grid is estimated using Random Forest model due to its capability in the prediction of multiple output values simultaneously.

articleTitle: Influence of dead band of turbine governors on ultra-low-frequency oscillation in Hydro-Dominant power system
abstract: The current research shows that turbine governors will introduce a very low frequency mode into the system, which may cause ultra-low-frequency oscillations (ULFO) in Hydro-Dominant power system. However, some ULFO happened near the dead band of turbine governors. So it is necessary to take into account the function of the dead band when studying ULFO. In this paper, to ULFO in Yunnan power grid, we provide a piecewise-linear system model considering the dead band. The oscillation waves of different types of dead bands and the damping of the frequency modes are studied. The results show that the step-response dead band will cause the frequency to oscillate near the dead zone even when the damping of the frequency mode is positive. And the no-step response dead band will cause the frequency to oscillate near the dead zone when the negative damping of the frequency mode is weak, and the oscillation will aggravate when the negative damping is strong. To avoid ULFO, the whole system needs to quit the step-response dead band, and ensure the positive damping of the frequency mode in power grid.

articleTitle: New generic model of wind turbine voltage ride-through for large-scale power system studies
abstract: With the rapid growth of wind power, the dynamic behaviour of the wind turbine generator (WTG) has a greater impact on the stability constraints of the power grid. Voltage ride through control is the most significant factor. However, the wind power control system involves lots of power electronic equipment, and there are so many WTG manufacturers, even worse, the structure and characteristics are significantly different between each other. Detailed modelling of every single WTG of large-scale power system is impossible. So, it is important to develop a simplified generic simulation model for large-scale power system studies. The IEC and the Western Electric Coordinating Council have done excellent jobs on WTG generic models. The generic models they proposed being widely used by the wind industry, but the voltage ride-through part is relatively not generic enough for large-scale power system studies. In this paper, a new generic WTG voltage ride-through model is proposed, which is based on operation states transition and unified characterization method of control strategy during the voltage ride-through process. Model validations are made by comparison of simulation results and measurements in voltage drop events.

articleTitle: On-line diagnosis method for transformer winding deformation based on running voltage and current correlation mining
abstract: When the transformer is subjected to a short-circuit or transport collision, the windings may be deformed under the action of electric power or mechanical force. Commonly used winding deformation diagnosis methods are all off-line diagnostic methods, which have the disadvantages of requiring the transformer to be out of service and high professional skills of the operator. To improve the accuracy and efficiency of winding deformation diagnosis, this paper proposed an online intelligent diagnosis method for winding deformation combined with information entropy (IE) and support vector machine (SVM). The method uses the permutation entropy (PE) and wavelet entropy (WE) to extract the characteristics of current and voltage signals, and comprehensively analyses the variation of the monitoring indicators in the complexity and time-frequency domain. The machine learning algorithm automatically learns the diagnosis logic from the fault features to realize the intelligent diagnosis of winding deformation. This study carried out training and testing on the real operating data of 29 transformers. The correct rate of diagnosis for deformation was 93.10%, and the correct rate of diagnosis for specific deformation positions reached 88.89%. This paper verifies the effectiveness of the online diagnostic model and the scalability between different types of transformers.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal dispatch method based on source-network-load-storage interaction system for DC distribution network
abstract: The DC distribution network can integrate the photovoltaic power generation system with high efficiency, but the random fluctuation of the photovoltaic output power is strong and there is a problem of PV consumption, which has a certain degree of impact on the economic optimization operation of the system. Therefore, the source-network-load-storage optimization interaction concept is introduced in the DC distribution network. Based on the in-depth analysis of the interactive load characteristics, the interaction load and energy storage technology can be fully utilized to the system to consumpt the photovoltaic. Combined with the features of DC distribution network structure, comprehensively consider the impact of the interactive load and energy storage system collaborative optimization on the system operating cost and power flow distribution, so that both the power generation side and the power side can participate in the resource optimization configuration of the grid operation. A multi-objective optimal scheduling model for photovoltaic DC distribution networks with operational cost, network loss and voltage deviation is established. The simulation example shows that: Collaborative optimization using interactive load and energy storage system can greatly reduce system operating cost, network loss and voltage deviation, effectively improve the level of PV consumption, and realize safe and reliable operation of DC distribution network.

articleTitle: Coordinated multiple HVDC modulation emergency control for enhancing power system transient stability
abstract: Large power impact in a short time will cause power oscillation or even cascading failures after the blocking of HVDC. EDCPS can greatly improve the post-disturbance transient stability of power system. Firstly, the relationship between the voltage level of the AC buses at both ends of the HVDC system and the operation modes of the HVDC system is studied, giving the explanation of limited EDCPS. Next, a methodology for calculating the HVDC line power boost ability is proposed with the consideration of the short-time overload capacity of converters, voltage stabilization level of the commutation bus, and voltage support capability of the AC grid. Finally, the power modulation strategy that coordinates multiple HVDC support capabilities is developed considering HVDC real-time boosting capability and steady limitation of power transfer interfaces. The proposed methodology has been tested in the real system. The simulation results indicate that the proposed methodology is able to quickly absorb the unbalanced energy accumulated during the fault process and improve the operational stability of AC/DC hybrid power grid.

articleTitle: Influence of circuit breaker features on switching overvoltage of 35kV shunt reactor on no-load busbar — I. theoretical and simulating analysis
abstract: When cutting off shunt reactor on no-load busbar, it is inevitable for phenomenon such as chopping current, arc reignition and equivalent chopping current to appear during the switching process. Overvoltage caused by the switching will lead to phase-to-phase fault of related equipment and interturn insulation damage of the shunt reactor, threatening the safety of electrical equipment. Equipment breakdowns caused by 35kV shunt reactor on no-load busbar switching overvoltage occur frequently in 220kV substation, endangering the safe and stable operation of the power grid. In this paper, the mechanism, perniciousness and suppression of shunt reactor switching overvoltage were analysed systematically. The suppressing effects of circuit breaker performance and position were compared, and the PSCAD simulation analysis were carried out.

articleTitle: Method for determining the minimum number of power-on units at the transmitting end of UHVDC considering transient over-voltage
abstract: When UHVDC is used for long-distance, large-capacity transmission of renewable energy power, the transient over-voltage problem at the transmitting end caused by UHVDC power disturbance becomes the main factor that restricts the DC transmission capability. This problem can be effectively alleviated by constructing thermal power units at the UHVDC transmission end. However, for the calculation of transient over-voltage of the transmitting end caused by the large-capacity UHVDC power disturbance, the simulation analysis method is mainly used, and there is no effective theoretical calculation method; for the determination of the minimum number of power-on units for the nearby thermal power units, the simulation analysis combined with the trial-and-test method is mainly used, and the workload is huge. Based on the single-branch voltage drop formula, this paper derives the formula of the transient voltage rise caused by the change of the node load, which is used to effectively evaluate the risk of the transient over-voltage at the transmitting end during the DC disturbance and determine the minimum number of power-on units for the nearby thermal power units. This method can significantly reduce the amount of work involved.

articleTitle: Optimal quasi-synchronous condenser and generator dispatch for voltage stability and peak-shaving
abstract: For AC power grid located at the receiving end of multi-infeed HVDC transmission system, fewer and fewer local generators are online for accepting a lot of external power. Active and reactive power regulation capacity of power grid is becoming weaken. Voltage stability and peak-shaving are faced with great challenges. The quasi-synchronous condenser can work at a lower power factor than the conventional generator, thus providing more reactive power for the power system. East China Power Grid adopts the method of transforming generators into quasi-synchronous condensers to enhance the monitor ability of active and reactive power in the power grid. An optimal modification scheme and dispatch method for voltage stability and peak-shaving by regulating those condensers and generators is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the support capability index of each generator and condenser, which can be used in modification scheme, is defined according to the normal vector of voltage stability limit surface. Then an optimal reactive power dispatch model is proposed under the constraints of peak-shaving. Finally, the optimal terminal voltage scheme is obtained by solving the model. The effectiveness of this method is verified by an example of IEEE39 system. The results suggest that, the modification scheme and dispatch method is able to improve the voltage stability margin and regulate the bus voltage of infeasible region into feasible region under the constraints of peak-shaving.

articleTitle: Evaluation of safety input and output benefits of power supply enterprises based on DEA method
abstract: The production and operation activities of power supply companies are always accompanied by safety inputs, and safety benefits naturally exist in the entire process of production and operation. Identifying and evaluating the safety input-output benefits of power supply enterprises, and identifying the shortcomings in the safety input process through benefit evaluation will help improve safety precautions, guide further safety investment and improve the output efficiency of safety inputs. This paper first constructs a security input-output index system for power supply enterprises based on data envelopment analysis. Secondly, considering that safety output is the focus of enterprises and needs to quantitatively analyze the value of safety investment, the C⁁2 R model with slack variables based on output is selected to construct the safety input-output evaluation of power supply enterprises based on DEA. model; Finally, this model is used to evaluate the safety input and output benefits of power supply enterprises in 9 regions of a southwestern province, and improvement measures are proposed based on the evaluation results. The results show that the research on safety input-output benefits is helpful for power supply enterprises to clarify their own deficiencies in safety input, thereby improving the level of safety input, and has certain guiding role and promotion significance for safety investment management of power supply enterprises.

articleTitle: Study on PLL parameter security region based on Gershgorin disc theorem and impedance method
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energies and power electronic devices, sub synchronous oscillations occur frequently. Phase-locked loop (PLL) is a key part for renewable energies integrating into power grid. Recent studies have shown that unreasonable setting of PLL parameters of is one of the important reasons for sub-synchronous oscillations. Impedance method is an effective method to study the system stability, but the obtained impedance is a two-dimensional matrix, which makes the analysis inconvenient. In order to preserve the simplicity of impedance method and ensure the accuracy of stability judgment, the Gershgorin disc theorem is applied to the generalized Nyquist criterion in this paper. Sufficient conditions of stability are derived, and the conservativeness of the method is improved. On this basis, the security region of the PLL control parameters is computed. Simulations verify the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Research on short-circuit current improvement algorithm of doubly fed wind farm based on low voltage ride through
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of low voltage ride through(LVRT) of wind farms, crowbar protection circuit has been widely used in doubly fed induction generator(DFIG). Aiming at the low accuracy of short-circuit current calculation method for wind farm with crowbar resistor at present, the doubly-fed wind turbines are accurately modeled, and the fault mechanism of wind turbines with crowbar circuit is emphatically analyzed in this paper. The formula of short-circuit current is deduced by using improved short-circuit calculation method, and further combined with the limit of the parameters in the actual design of the wind farm engineering, the practicality of the short-circuit point calculation formula is optimized, and finally the accuracy of the short-circuit current design threshold of the wind farm is improved. Compared with the traditional national standard calculation method, the practical calculation method for short-circuit current of crowbar protection doubly-fed wind turbines generator is accurate and convenient, which is of great significance to the electrical safety design of wind farm.

articleTitle: Overview of adaptive reclosing technique and the challenge faced in AC/DC hybrid power grid
abstract: Adaptive reclosing, which can identify the permanent fault and transient fault, is instrumental in improving power system stability. Existing adaptive reclosing methods mainly aim at AC power transmission lines. With the development of the DC power transmission system, it is necessary to discuss the adaptive reclosing in AC/DC hybrid power system. For single-phase grounding fault, the recovery voltage of fault phase after breaker tripping is studied in this paper. Different methods to the adaptive reclosing in AC power transmission lines are summarized, and the recovery voltage in AC/DC hybrid power grid is studied by PSCAD. The new problems of the adaptive reclosing in AC/DC hybrid power system are discussed. Then the follow-up ideas to solve several existing problems are also presented.

articleTitle: Influence of circuit breaker features on switching overvoltage of 35kV shunt reactor on no-load busbar — II. onsite testing and comparison
abstract: When cutting off shunt reactor on no-load busbar, it is inevitable for phenomenon such as chopping current, arc reignition and equivalent chopping current to appear during the switching process. Overvoltage caused by the switching will lead to phase-to-phase fault of related equipment and interturn insulation damage of the shunt reactor, threatening the safety of electrical equipment. Equipment breakdowns caused by 35kV shunt reactor on no-load busbar switching overvoltage occur frequently in 220kV substation, endangering the safe and stable operation of the power grid. In this paper, the suppressing effects of circuit breaker performance and position were compared, and the onsite overvoltage measurement was carried out. The work and conclusion of this paper provide the solutions and engineering experience for the switching overvoltage suppression of 35kV shunt reactor on no-load busbar.

articleTitle: Day-ahead optimal scheduling of district-level integrated energy system considering data centre
abstract: With the rapid development of the information technology industry, data centres (DCs) spring up in recent years, deeply impacting the traditional energy system. This paper proposes a novel day-ahead optimal scheduling method for district-level integrated energy system (DIES) considering the integration of DCs. Firstly, all components in the DIES are modelled specifically, including energy station, network and DCs. Then, the optimal scheduling model is constructed aimed at minimizing the comprehensive cost. Constraints of energy purchase, energy station, energy subsystems and DCs are all contained, where different DCs can cooperate to deal with the computing workloads. The initial problem is finally simplified to a second-order cone programming (SOCP), which can be solved directly by Gurobi. Case studies are carried out on a test DIES which aggregates three DCs. Results show that DCs can optimize the power flow by transferring the computing workloads through the Internet, and reduce the total cost.

articleTitle: Research on regulation compensation allocation method of virtual power plant
abstract: Virtual power plants can aggregate a large number of distributed power sources to participate in the regulation market, and improve its regulation performance then enhance its economic benefits in the regulation market through optimal control technology. Therefore, the method to evaluate the contribution of each generator in virtual power plant set to the regulation and allocate the regulation compensation according to each generator's contribution becomes an inevitable problem of the virtual power plant. In view of the above problems, this paper first analyses the influencing factors of the regulation performance and the calculation model of the distributed generator or virtual power plant. Secondly, this paper establishes a regulation contribution assessment model for generators in virtual power plants. Finally, based on the proposed regulation contribution assessment model, this paper proposes a virtual power plant regulation compensation allocation method. The case study shows that the proposed method can effectively stimulate the generators set to improve the regulation performance.

articleTitle: A multi-criteria dynamic reactive power optimal allocation method based on the characteristics of weak sending-end system
abstract: The reactive power/voltage support capability of DC sending-end system with large-scale renewable energy access is insufficient, thus forming a weak sending grid. Based on the characteristics of weak sending-end power grid, a multi-criteria dynamic reactive power optimal allocation method is proposed in this paper. According to the characteristics of DC and renewable energy access, the distance coupling index is proposed to get the vulnerable nodes from the topological structure; through the analysis of the transient voltage instability standard, the voltage sag risk index is proposed to select the important nodes to maintain the transient voltage stability; combined with the two indicators, the candidate compensation set is determined. Using the improved trajectory sensitivity index, the effect of voltage lifting of reactive power compensation device installed at different nodes is analyzed, and the optimal compensation point is determined. Finally, considering the economy, the optimal compensation scheme is proposed. In case studies, the improved 37-bus system is used to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of fatigue life loss of drivetrain of doubly-fed wind turbines under suort-circuit fault of power grid
abstract: The shafting drivetrain of the doubly fed wind turbine is the part with the highest failure rate. The electromagnetic torque fluctuation caused by the grid fault easily results in the torsional vibration fatigue loss of the shaft. Accordingly, the influences of drivetrain fatigue life loss under different grid faults require investigation. Firstly, the four-mass model of the drivetrain is constructed on the basis of MATLAB/Simulink. Secondly, the electromagnetic torque response under short-circuit fault of the grid is obtained via model simulation. Finally, the effects of different types of grid faults on the fatigue life of the drivetrain are analysed through Mlife. Results show that the electromagnetic torque fluctuation load generated by grid fault has no apparent influence on the fatigue life of the drivetrain in the short term, but the cumulative effect of short-term damage will aggravate the fatigue life loss of the drivetrain and increase the failure risk of the component. The electromagnetic torque generated by the three-phase symmetrical short-circuit is the most violent and has the maximum effect on the fatigue life of the drivetrain.

articleTitle: Reinforcement learning driven self-optimizing operation for distributed battery electrical storage system
abstract: With the fast growth of DBESS ( distributed battery electrical storage system ) integration, how to operate the widely dispersed storage units economically has increasingly attracted investigation in the recent decade. The traditional centralized modeling idea has higher requirements on model assumptions, communication parameters and market model, and has gradually failed to adapt to the demands of individual autonomous optimization. Therefore, a self-optimizing operation of DBESS using reinforcement learning is proposed, which could avert the intricacy that the centralized model is difficult to accurately physically model due to the above high requirements. Firstly, based on periodism and volatility of electricity price, the objective function was established for realizing maximum benefits by the help of storage aggregators; Secondly, Q-learning which is the most widely used reinforcement learning and considering the DBESS cost of a single call as iterative penalty function, to figure out the optimal charging/discharging strategy by iterative calculation. Thirdly, tested by the electricity prices of Ontario, Canada in 2018, the algorithm always keeps reasonable profitability with the different parameters of DBESS and gained more 40% earnings than Self-set price segmentation algorithm of DBESS. Finally, further investigation shall focus on DQN to conquer SOC discontinuity.

articleTitle: Analysis of interaction between wind turbines in wind farm based on small signal model of doubly-fed wind turbine
abstract: As the penetration rate of renewable energy in the system becomes higher and higher, the interaction between renewable energy and the system becomes more and more obvious. Taking a wind farm as an example, a single wind turbine and system are coupled together by the voltage of the wind turbine. The voltage of the wind turbine is determined by the internal potential of the wind turbine and the grid voltage. When the wind power penetration rate in the system is relatively high, the influence of the potential of the wind turbine on the voltage will be as important as the influence of the system on the internal potential. The system disturbance will have a dynamic impact on the voltage of the wind turbine. Since the convertor of the wind turbine is strongly dependent on the voltage, the dynamics of the voltage will bring about the dynamics of the wind turbine convertor. When there is disturbance on the wind turbine side, the dynamics of the wind turbine power will affect the voltage, which in turn affects the voltage of each node of the power system. Therefore, the system has a strong interaction between the wind turbine and the grid under high wind power penetration. In this paper, the current mainstream model doubly-fed wind turbine wind farm is taken as an example. Firstly, the influence of system power grid dynamics under different power variations on the dynamic behavior of doubly-fed wind farm integration is analyzed. On this basis, the influence of the power collection line of electrical connection in the wind farm on its dynamic characteristics is studied, and the analysis of the interaction of the wind turbines in the wind farm is realized.

Author Keywords: Interaction Between Wind Turbines in Wind Farm

articleTitle: Research on access location scheme of multi-port power electronic transformer in AC/DC hybrid distribution network
abstract: The wide access of high proportion distributed new energy resources brings forth a multitude of challenges to distribution network. Simultaneously, the proportion of DC load and the number of rectifiers and inverters in traditional power supply and distribution network is increasing, which renders the control of distribution network more complex. In this paper, a multi-port power electronic transformer (PET) AC/DC hybrid distribution network structure with multiple voltage levels is proposed, which acknowledges centralized access of distributed new energy resources. A general energy efficiency model of multi-port PET and AC/DC hybrid system is conformed. Laid on the grounds of non-dominated sorted genetic algorithm-II (NSGA-II), a bi-level and multi-scenario collaborative optimal allocation model is adopted to unravel the access location scheme of multi-port PET system for the IEEE 33 nodes distribution network system. The results exhibit rapid and effective solution to the challenges of high-proportion distributed new energy through the proposed scheme. The optimal allocation of PET in AC/DC hybrid distribution network can improve the absorption rate of new energy resources.

articleTitle: A control strategy for battery energy storage smoothing short-term wind power fluctuation based on ANN
abstract: With the Grid-connected scale of wind generators increasing, the random fluctuation of wind power has been one of the critical issues for the consumption of wind power. From the perspective of how to use the battery energy storage system (BESS) to smooth the wind power fluctuation, the control scheme for two BESSs using the alternative charging/discharging strategy to smooth the wind power fluctuation is proposed at first. Then, the design method for determining the capacity of the two BESSs based on the statistics of wind power fluctuation is studied. Due to the adaptive neural network (ANN) has the excellent ability in setting up the non-linear mapping between the input and output of the controlled object whose model is difficult for building, the ANN is therefore used to generate the reference command for BES Ss smoothing the short-term and strongly random wind power fluctuation. At the same time, the improved method for adaptively adjusting the weight of neurons based on modifying deviation latch is proposed to improve the accuracy of ANN on predicting the short term wind power fluctuation. Finally, both the feasibility of both the proposed charging and discharging strategy in saving the battery cycle life and the effectiveness of the proposed ANN control strategy in smoothing the short-term wind power fluctuation is validated by simulating in the improved 11-bus wind power system.

articleTitle: Frequency response characteristic analysis of SSCI for DFIG-based wind farms considering rotor speed control based on complex torque coefficients method
abstract: The sub-synchronous control interaction (SSCI) in the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farm is mainly caused by the interaction among the multiple dynamic controllers of the wind turbine and fixed series capacitor in the transmission line. In this paper, starting from the rotor voltage equation of DFIG, the transfer function of the electromagnetic torque to the rotor speed is derived based on the rotor speed control and the rotor side converter (RSC). Then, the electrical damping coefficient expression for evaluating the SSCI stability of DFIG based wind farm grid-connected to system with the series compensated transmission line is further proposed based on the complex torque coefficient method. Based on the electrical damping coefficient expression of the electromagnetic torque, the effects of the wind speed, the compensation level, the parameters of the rotor speed control and RSC control on SSCI stability are analysed. The analysis results shows that the instability of SSCI may appear caused by reducing wind speed, increasing serial compensation level, increasing the proportion and the integral parameters of the RSC controller. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of analysing the SSCI stability characteristic based on the proposed electrical damping characteristic is validated by the time-domain simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Energy Internet optimization scheduling for wind energy consumption considering high-energy load and electricity-to-gas
abstract: Energy Internet has deepened the connection between power grid, natural gas network and heat network, improving the flexibility of system operation. P2G deepens the coupling between the grid and natural gas network. The cooperation of P2G and energy storage device realizes the space-time translation of energy, which provides an effective way for new energy consumption and peak shaving and valley filling. High-energy load as a demand response with high energy efficiency is an effective form to promote wind power consumption. Considering the economics of system operation and the goal of maximizing the consumption of wind power, this paper proposes an energy Internet optimization scheduling strategy that comprehensively utilizes P2G equipment and high energy load. The load agent coordination layer collects schedulable information of high-energy enterprises and reports them to the dispatching center. The dispatching center issues a dispatching plan according to the objective function and the constraint conditions. In the objective function, in order to reflect the ability of the strategy to absorb wind power, a discarding penalty item is added. The effectiveness of the scheduling strategy is verified by an example to improve the economics of the system while maximizing the consumption of wind power.

articleTitle: Transient energy analysis and dissipation of a bipolar MTDC wind power integrating system during MMC outage
abstract: Using high-voltage direct current grid (HVDC grid) to integrate wind power is an effective solution to improve the flexibility and reliability of power transmission. Since the DC grid requires fault ride-through capability, hybrid modular multilevel converter (hybrid MMC) is adopted to form the bipolar DC grid. The MMC non-blocking operation strategy of unipolar converter outage is proposed. During the fault, the AC voltage at the integration point is stable, and the wind turbine can maintain its normal operation. To satisfy various dissipation requirements of the surplus wind power during the fault period, an adaptive control strategy of dissipation resistors is designed. Finally, the simulation based on PSCAD/EMTDC platform verifies the MMC unblocking fault ride-through operation of hybrid MTDC grid and proves the effectiveness of its fault energy dissipation.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of partial discharge in needle plate oil gap under compound voltage
abstract: In order to send renewable energy such as solar energy, wind energy and geothermal energy from the western region to the east region, the ultra high voltage direct current transmission (UHVDC)has been vigorously promoted in China. However, the insulation faults of converter transformer occur frequently in recent years with the development of UHVDC. With the influence of the AC-DC combined voltage, the partial discharge characteristics and mechanism of oil-pressboard insulation will be more complex. In this paper, an experimental platform for transformer oil insulation partial discharge under AC and DC composite voltage is built, and a model for simulation is established. By recording different interface charge densities, voltage amplitudes and the shape of the flow channel under different oil gap widths, the classification of partial discharges under AC/DC composite voltage is obtained. In addition, it also analyzes the developing speed of various discharges and the time as the dominant type, as well as the influence of factors such as voltage amplitude, oil gap width and interface charge density on the development speed and time. The research results will provide a theoretical basis for the insulation fault diagnosis under the composite voltage and the study of characteristics of partial discharge.

articleTitle: Design of the renewable portfolio standards based renewable energy certificate trading mechanism in China
abstract: Based on the analysis of China's current voluntary renewable energy certificate (REC) trading, this paper aims to study and analyze China's policies for renewable portfolio standards (RPS) and their requirements on REC trading, and to put forward China's RPS-based REC Mechanism from perspectives such as main market player management, the REC trading process, value-added services, information sharing and interaction and information disclosure, thus helping electricity trading centers develop REC trading, subject to RPS. The results of this study show that two modules, namely, the voluntary REC subscription and the REC trading contributing to achievement of quota targets, should be taken into account for designing China's REC mechanism, and it is important to establish sound connections of such design with the voluntary REC trading system of the China National Renewable Energy Information Management Centre (CNREIMC), the renewable energy subsidy distribution system and the RPS of green certificate trading centers.

articleTitle: Wind turbine wake simulation based on improved actuator disk considering nacelle and tower
abstract: The wake simulation for the wind farm based on the actuator disk model(ADM) with simple geometry structure, and the engineering k-ε turbulence model, which has a certain calculation accuracy and is widely used in micro-siting and power generation optimization calculation of wind farm. But the ADM lacks the influence of considering the nacelle and tower on the wake region, and the simplified rotor overestimates the recovery of wake velocity. Therefore, a numerical simulation method based on improved ADM considering nacelle and tower simultaneously is proposed, by introducing the nacelle and tower into the incompressible N-S equations in the form of body force source term. Taking the TNO wind tunnel wake test as an example, compared with other wake models, the proposed method improves the wake prediction accuracy overall.

articleTitle: A two-layer control method for inverter ACs to provide frequency regulation service based on indoor temperature-varying model
abstract: The frequency regulation service is playing an increasingly important role in the power system with high penetration of renewable energy integration. Since the inverter air-conditions (ACs) could change the operating power continuously and the indoor temperature of the buildings fluctuate slightly with a short-term power change, inverter ACs are considered as important demand response to the frequency regulation service. In this paper, the equivalent thermal parameter model of an inverter AC is introduced and the indoor temperature-varying model is established. Then, in order to improve the regulation capacity, a two-layer control method considering a virtual AGC generator to conduct grouping coordination control over the AC aggregators is proposed to provide frequency regulation service based on the indoor temperature-varying model. Simulation results demonstrate that the control method has improved the total frequency regulation capacity of the AC aggregators and the inverter ACs have a good performance in providing the frequency regulation service under the two-layer control method.

articleTitle: Robust approximation models for predictive control of a variable pitch wind power drivetrain
abstract: This paper proposes a data-driven system identification strategy resulting in robust approximation models with minimal prediction-error for a wind turbine drivetrain. Based on this approximation model, a predictive controller is designed and tested on a variable wind profile. Non-linear models of a 10 kW and a 1.5 MW variable-pitch wind turbine are developed, based on a Nonlinear Auto Regressive with eXogenous (N-ARX) and a discrete-time state space model for approximating the wind turbine's dynamical behaviour. The model is based on the advanced NREL wind turbine simulator FAST. In this study, the approximation model has the wind speed, pitch angle and rotor speed as input variables, and the electrical power output as output. Simulation results reflect the interactions that occur between all three input variables affecting the wind turbine's operational performance. Moreover, using our approach, the predictive controller is designed to deal with non-linear system characteristics and wind variability. Results show the robustness of the controller based on the approximation model towards high wind speeds and high turbulent wind conditions.

articleTitle: Study on the variation of the steady-state frequency of power systems under the rapid growth of renewable energies
abstract: The power grid of China is going through a rapid growth of renewable energies, which can change the frequency stability characteristics of the power system. In this paper, we study the variations of the steady-state frequency caused by the load changes in the power system with the penetration of renewable energies. An analytic model is firstly constructed to analyse the steady-state frequency of a simple power system. Two scenarios with/without the participation of new energy power generation in the primary frequency are considered. We find that increased renewable energies deteriorates the frequency stability of the system. A drastic change of the system frequency stability occurs when the renewable energy power generation reaches a specific proportion. This proportion will rise if renewable energy has a certain ability to participate in the system frequency control. We do simulations on power system test cases generated by modifying the IEEE 9 Bus Test Case. Simulation results verified the correctness of the model and the analytical conclusions obtained.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of wind turbine via controllers coordination and sensitivity analysis
abstract: In this paper, a sensitivity-analysis-based wind turbine optimization strategy is introduced to improve the power output stability while reducing the shaft and tower loads. Both generator torque and blade pitch are controlled coordinately to achieve the optimization. During the wind turbine control process, blade pitch and generator torque are controlled proportionally to the generator speed tracking error, which simplifies the controller structure, thus, the wind turbine performance can be evaluated with control variables sensitivities directly. The wind turbine performance is considered in output power stability, shaft bending moment and tower bending moment. Both load parameters are analysed in fatigue damage lifetime. A conflicting relationship is realized between the load-power characteristic during the optimization, and a global coordination solution is selected on the pareto optimal frontier. Essential, this work is an exploration for the quantitative analysis from the wind turbine load performance to the control variables sensitivities directly without the limitation of controller forms. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: A coordinated control strategy of electric spring based smart load technology
abstract: With the increasing adoption of distributed renewable energy sources and single-phase electrical equipment, the issue of voltage fluctuation and power imbalance become more critical problems that need to be resolved urgently. The so-called demand side management (DSM) provides the opportunity for the distribution system to intelligently balance the power between grid side and demand side. As one of the crucial roles of DSM, smart loads are naturally committed to manage the power flow of the distribution network. Different to the conventional passive smart load technologies, the electric springs (ES) provide an opportunity to turn part of the traditional loads into adaptive smart load without the need for communication. In this paper, a novel coordinated control strategy of ES based smart load is presented, other than the previous ES which offer single function, the ES with proposed control strategy can achieve both voltage stabilization and power balance functions via dynamic active power and reactive power regulation. A test system with different ES model is built in MATLAB/Simulink for system simulation, and a comparison is made between proposed and existed control strategies. The simulation results validated the effectiveness of this multi-objective coordinated control strategy of ES for solving complex power quality issues.

articleTitle: Robust co-planning of transmission and energy storage considering uncertainty correlation
abstract: As uncertainty correlations confine variations of renewable energy and load demand, it possibly obstacles the worst-case incidence and alter planning schemes in the end. Meanwhile, coordinating energy storage system and transmission network trends to benefit for the reduction of imbalanced power in the presence of high-penetration renewable energy. This paper proposes an innovative robust model for joint transmission and energy storage expansion planning, which adopts the underlying idea of the self-adaptive uncertainty sets to characterize uncertainty intervals and correlation sets to eliminate unlike-happen scenarios. For constructing the correlation sets, the linear correlations between renewable energy and load demand are depicted by the first-order moving average (MA) model. Furthermore, the tri-level robust optimization problem is decoupled into a master problem and a sub-problem based on the framework of column-and-constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm. And the solution of the bilinear problem in the sub-problem can be averted through the block coordinate descent method, which takes iterations of lower-middle level problems and the approximation of first-order Taylor series into consideration.
